The Hour and the Certainty of its Occurrence-

The Hour and the Certainty of Its Occurrence

The question of the Hour is regarded as one of the most obscure and confusing questions for Muslims, and even for Christians and Jews. The Muslim and Christian scholars mistook the Hour of the return of the Messiah master (pth) to be the Hour of Resurrection. This is why their sayings suggest that the Hour that the Messiah master will come is the same Hour when people will be resurrected.

Because the conception of the Hour was kept in darkness and was baffling to them, they also failed to perceive the purpose of the return of the Messiah master (pth).

The Jews did not recognize the Messiah master the first time he came, and are waiting for the coming of the one they believe will be the true Messiah master. They hope that he will reinstate their faded might and fallen glory once he has become king of the whole world.

The Christians are hoping that the Messiah master will allow them to enter the kingdom of the Heavenly Father after he has borne their sins, having sacrificed himself because of original sin. They think that he will come in spirit rather than in soul and body.

As for the Muslims, their wish for Jesus’ return is that he will kill the Antichrist and the Jews and break the cross. They think that the events associated with his coming will not affect them negatively, in spite of their present states.

Those are their wishes, but the truth is not like that at all. The truth is that you must become acquainted with the Owner of righteousness and truth. If you yourself discover the truth of God’s Existence through your own reflection on this universe, and believe in God with a real belief, you will find that the answers to all of your questions have become completely clear and visible in His Speech in the Holy Qur’an.

For this reason, you will find no references in this book except for the Holy Qur’an, containing the heavenly pages, the Torah, the Psalter, the Gospel and the noble Prophetic Sun’na, a practical explanation of the meanings of the Qur’an.

The Almighty Al’lah (glory to Him) has neglected nothing in the Qur’an and has revealed everything in its pages.

God says:

“All the beasts that roam the earth and all the birds that take wing in flight are communities like your own. We have left out nothing in the Book. They shall all be gathered before their Provider.”

109

He also says:

“The day will surely come when We shall call from every nation a witness against them like themselves

(like themselves in appearance, but with a reality that is great and sublime)

, and We shall call you as a witness against them

(the Envoys)

, for to you We have revealed the Book which manifests everything: a guide, compassion, and good news for those who submit to Al’lah.”

110

Before us we have a new concept, which you can say comes before the truth of our status quo. This concept is quite new and totally strange in comparison with the reported words once heard by people. This certain and actual truth is based on extracting from the Qur’an alone (taking notes, facts and science only from the Qur’an), which includes the Sun’na, the Prophetic tradition, our jurisprudence, and everything that benefits and blesses humanity both here and in the hereafter. The Qur’an is the only source of our science.

In fact, it is habitual, customary belief that renders the Qur’an obscure and dark for people, and this kind of belief is not founded on a self-certainty that has been accomplished by searching and reasoning. This type of faith, based on uncertainty, is what creates a hidden veil between us and the sublime and lofty meanings of the Qur’an, and prevents us from understanding the weighty speech revealed to the noble Envoy (cpth) by Almighty God. This truth may sometimes agree with or correspond to what the ancients have said, but most of the time, it is in conflict with them. Therefore, we do not want to discuss their sayings or their opposing views. We do not intend to refute one saying and then affirm another, and then conclude with a moderate view collated from all of these different opinions, in order to publish a book that has been created by doing nothing other than gathering and assorting what the ancients have said. We will not do this and then say to people that we have composed a book

-

the fact would be that we had simply put the sayings of the ancients together in a new volume.

§§§§§

Now, let us return to the case of the Hour, seeking to clarify its meaning from the inexhaustible headspring and the source which has absolutely no deviation or contradiction. This is the Book whose verses were firmly connected and then detailed by Wise and All-Knowing One.

In the first chapter, we mentioned the most significant deeds and creeds of most of the ruined nations that have come before, and have revealed the reasons for their destruction. In this chapter, we want to review the actions and the creeds of humanity at the present time, and then we will compare their actions and creeds with those of the earlier nations we discussed. After this comparison is completed, we will know whether we will be saved from the forthcoming ruin, or if we will face the same end as those who went before, in the case that we do not change our wrongful conduct and fail to submit to God’s Legislation, as revealed in His Holy Book.

The tenets of the destroyed peoples do not differ from those of contemporary nations concerning their core or their content.

Nothing has changed other than the external form and certain transient things. Human spirits do not change with changes of time and place. The only thing that changes is what truth or falsehood the spirit perceives or contains: whatever facts or illusions are held within. According to this perception or this content, thought

-

working on behalf of the spirit

-

searches for reasons in order to rationalize the beliefs and inclinations of the spirit. Since the spirit is veiled from its Provider, it contains nothing but worldly desires and its own desires. As it sees nothing except for pictures and external forms of things with the eyes of the head, therefore changes in its tenets are only the changes and turns which happen to the material or physical shape. That is what we mean by ‘transient things’.

The extinct nations had worshiped the planets, and had made symbols of them in order to draw benefits or avert evils. Such beliefs resulted from their attachment to appearances without seeing the realities of things. If we consider their creeds to be silly and to be disdained, the creeds of the present nations are not any less silly or less worthy of disdain. No matter how the nations change and their formalities are renewed, the quiddity will stay the same.

People of contemporary times have exchanged various gods for many new ones. Some of them have made nature into a god, and others have taken a superior mind to be their god. For example, in the view of communism, nature came first and is the creator, and it disclosed the secret of its creation to none except its messengers Darwin, Marx, Engels and Lenin.

Darwin’s theory of evolution

-

natural selection, or the better remains

-

has paved the way for others to create their theory, called dialectics. This theory, which clarifies the basis of creation and provision, depends on three bases:

- First:

changing quantitative changes into qualitative ones: this idea was suggested to Darwin and his colleagues by nature. In short, it denotes that the dissimilarity among natural phenomena is quantitative; that is, they are only actions of assembly and synthesis; their quality does not change. This mechanical explanation for evolution led to many mistakes, so that their theory was met with deadly criticism.

-Second: the unit of struggling oppositions: according to the claims of communism, this is a rule governing the mutual relations between something’s content and form, and between its intrinsic nature and its external appearance. These mutual relations mean that all things and phenomena are marked by an interior contradiction, and everything is a unit of oppositions. These oppositions are negative and positive, of past and of future, and contain both old things that are approaching death and others that are about to rise and evolve. The struggle between these contrary currents is the source of evolution and the power that drives it. According to this account, the stage where these oppositions are dissolved is very important for the process of evolution. Thus, when an old thing uses itself up and becomes an obstacle to the new, the opposition between them should be broken through the disappearance of the old and the triumph of the new.

-The third: the rule of banishing the banisher: according to this rule an old quality is expelled and replaced with a new one. For example: the bourgeoisie took the place of the feudal lords after feudalism was expelled, and socialism will supplant capitalism. Accordingly, communism will displace socialism, and as a result of this struggle, a day must come when communism will be eradicated from the earth.

111

Thus the messengers of nature admitted that their god is blind and thoughtless, and the aims of its creation are accomplished unconsciously. However, even if this god was blind and thoughtless there was no problem, since it created conscious creatures and arranged everything in a rational way with perfect accuracy and excellence, with all things logically integrated together! This perfection of arrangement and this secret of all creation came into being purely by accident!

Have you ever seen a higher level of foolishness in any other creed, or any blindness greater than this? Is this not a gross error? Does a random accident reoccur? If it does, it will be a rule that is controlled by a will. Who allows the sun to rise at the same moment of every day in every year? Is this an accident?

No wonder!

“…for any of whom God gives no light, he will have no light.”

112

Anyone who does not believe that there is no god except Al’lah is dark-hearted, and their only light is the light of this passing life. There is another god prevailing in this age, which is the mind-god or the science-god. This god is itself one of the human race, but excels above ordinary people through its superior intelligence and power of discovery and invention. Human beings hope that these superior gods will fulfill all that they aspire to, replacing the old god who has passed away, according to the conviction of the philosopher Nietzsche.

This god

-

that is, the superior human being

-

is a fruit of nature, which is the god of Marx and his like. However, this god seeks rebellion against his godmother in order to make it subservient to his volition, so that he can act freely with nature. His godmother is not only blind and thoughtless, but also giddy and unfair. She gives him only a little, despite her abundant wealth. Through his striving for control over nature, this god wants to create the gardens of bliss on the earth. This god or this child, ungrateful to his mother, has not yet contented himself with commanding her. Instead, he seeks to plunder the secret of life from her. He hates to remain at her mercy or under her guardianship, so that she can put him to death whenever she likes, so depriving him of enjoyment of life. From his perspective, his mother acts without purpose in relation to the fate of creation. The great technological progress that has been achieved by humanity is what makes people accept the trifling idea of this new god, believing in its power, so that what it produces and facilitates

-

such as technology, civilization, advanced weaponry and a luxurious lifestyle

-

has become their chief concern in the present time. However, apart from this, he has created troubles for them that are a hundredfold more than their enjoyment of its results; even apart from the weapons of mass destruction he has made, which almost have the power to extinguish nature along with most of humanity.

As for the statute of this god, it has appeared as a normal result of what he has produced. He has taught people stinginess, greed, cunning, deception, debauchery, roughness, oppression and treason. In other words, these gods are able to corrupt the spirit of humanity and consequently, they have subverted its life. To attain the ornament and embellishment that this god has created, the human race had to sink unrestrainedly into this worldly life, and had to employ all of their abilities and faculties in order to fulfill the requirements of living in the human community; to do so it was necessary for people to become dissolute misers, swindlers, liars and robbers. The statute of this god did not stop here, but also extended to shackling people and divesting them of their freedoms. Thus the human person has become something without value; it is considered to be a negligible element, as if it has turned into a part of the solid machine of this god.

I wish that I knew how humanity could relish a life dependant on wrongfulness, dissipation, struggle and slavery! How can happiness be achieved in a society that lives a life loaded with spite and hypocrisy? The happiness that is hoped for under the wing of this science-god is merely an illusion, pictured in the imagination of those who are infatuated with this idea. How can happiness be found in a society that has lost all humanist principles and humane attributes?

The people of the contemporary age have been stripped of all humanist merits. They have substituted beastly values for those of humanity, and depend on a rapacious and deceitful set of beliefs. They have adopted depravity instead of morality, and have commuted their supreme laws for the law of the jungle.

God says:

“We have gathered many jinns and many men for Hell. They have hearts, yet they do not understand; eyes, yet they do not see; and ears, yet they do not hear. They are like beasts-indeed, they are even more misled. These are in the valley of oblivion.”

113

These are examples of the most important creeds that have been invented in the atomic age. Do we think that the ancient nations had reached the same degree as the people of the current time in their disbelief in their Creator and Provider? Had they denied the Existence of the Creator, as the people of this time do?

The first devil did not deny either the Creator’s Existence or the Godly Might and Providence, despite his extreme disbelief, but he did deny the Godly Justice.

“He

(the devil)

said: ‘oh, my Provider! Since You have led me astray, I will seduce them

(humankind)

on earth’...”

114

In another Fortress the devil said:

“I swear by Your Glory that I will misguide them all.”

115

He thought that God unjustly preferred our master Adam over him. Similarly, the idolaters did not deny God’s Existence, but thought that their idols were a means that would draw them nearer to God. However, the judgement that God is dead (those mad people) or the denial of His Existence have not issued from our forefathers. It has now become normal to see people reaching such a degree of unbelief, denial and ungratefulness, and Satan will probably be a student of the leader of the unbelievers, being taught by them about how to mislead people. Infidelity has its own rules, and belief has its own rules, too. Each of them increases or decreases in their conformity with following this way or that way. Either of these two ways that is adopted by people draws them far from the other.

Since most people in this time have chosen the way of the worldly life, and have become satisfied and pleased with it, we do not find it strange that such sayings are uttered from their mouths, or that such deeds are performed by them. This happens in human society in general but in European communities in particular.

As regards the path of the other abode

-

that is to say, the path leading to God

-

it is in the opposite direction to that of the lower life. The more a person frees themselves from love of this world, the more they approach God, and the more His Way will be passable before them. If their heart contains anything of this life, they will remain attached to it in a deal proportional to the degree of their heart’s inclination to it. However, the moment they release themselves from its shackles, they will dispose of the greatest obstacle that stands in the way of their journey to God. At that point the truth will appear clearly to them, lucid and unveiled.

In fact, loving this lower life is the reason that we do not discern the truth, for the spirit remembers nothing except what it comprehends, and understands nothing except what it contains. If it heads for the present life, it will be filled with desires to the degree that it has sunk into the worldly life. These lusts will cover the spirit, and become a barrier that prevents it from listening to the truth. Therefore when the truth is recited before the spirit, it will have no effect on it, nor will the spirit find it in the least bit interesting. This is because this spirit itself includes nothing of the truth, and consequently, it will apprehend nothing of it.

God says:

“When you recite the Qur’an, We place a hidden barrier between you and those who deny the life to come. We cast a veil upon their hearts so that they do not understand it, and make them hard of hearing. And when you mention your One and Only Provider in the Qur’an, they turn their backs in flight. We well know what they like to hear; they listen to you while they converse in private; the wrongdoers say: the man you follow is surely bewitched.”

116

Thus they converse secretly with the devil for this lowly life, and the devil whispers to them and makes their foul deeds seem fair to them, as they are far from Al’lah, just like him, and love of this passing life has possessed their hearts.

God says:

“They said: ‘that to which you call us cannot reach our hearts, for they are well protected. Our ears are stopped and a thick veil stands between us. Do as you please and so will we’.”:

here, God describes their state and mentions what they are saying:

“our hearts are veiled and relieved of what you order us to do; we do not want to hear your revelations, so keep to your world and let us keep to ours.”

117

The impermanent life is their utmost aspiration. When, on the other hand, the Qur’an becomes a reminder and a guide for the believer, it reminds them of the facts they have witnessed with the eye of their spirit. The more they comprehend these facts, the ampler and deeper facts they will find in the Qur’an, which will then seem to be like a translation of the contents of their spirit or the facts they have witnessed and which they attain through their thinking of the cosmic signs and contemplation of the creation of Al’lah.

Whatever ladders of sacredness in perfection and science that humanity ascends, and whatever intellectual and mental facts they perceive, they will find that the Qur’an has not only established these things beforehand, but also explains and details them more fully. Through such an understanding of the Qur’an, a believer will glorify the Envoy, who states the facts of the Qur’an in great detail because of the Godly and worldly science and perfection that his noble spirit (cpth) contains

-

which cannot be approached by any other in all the worlds. How can this be otherwise when he (cpth) has reached the highest heights of perfection, compassion, and divine science? Although the Qur’an is a reminder to all humankind, none can touch its sublime meanings except the scientists of God’s Attributes, who fear their Provider since discovering His Presence after their previous existence in oblivion.

Therefore, the Almighty God orders His Envoys to remind people of Al’lah’s Pledge and Compact, of the resurrection and accounting, and to think about all that is ascribed to their Creator, Provider, and the Universe-Steering God. However, this reminder was not intended to be recited haphazardly by the Envoys, without the Revelation of God’s Presence. As for those who have attained scientific knowledge about the Qur’an and who have understood its lofty meanings, they receive this Godly Revelation through their spiritual link with the Envoy (cpth). This point is very important; that is, to know that the Envoy does not know what is in the spirits of humanity. Al’lah alone is Omniscient, and Al’lah alone knows all that is secret or hidden, and it is He (glory to Him) Who reveals to the Envoy what words he should utter when meeting people. The words chosen by God will be surely the most suitable ones for them at that moment.

Therefore, the Almighty inspired His noble Envoy not to be quick to recite the Qur’an before its Revelation had been completed. This admonition was not confined only to the noble Envoy (cpth). In His Holy Book, the Almighty mentions that none of the Envoys should speak until He has spoken.

118

That is why they are impeccable. It is because they say nothing until after God has spoken and has bid them to speak. They are His unerring and honoured obedient followers (ibad).

119

The Almighty alone is aware of the secrets hidden within the spirits of His creation (ibad), so that He allows nobody to know what is hidden in the spirit of any other person. One of His Attributes is ‘the ‘Dark-Keeper of hidden secrets.’ For this reason, it is He Who inspires the Envoy to speak with this word or that one. Although the Envoys’ words are true, they do not know which words are most appropriate at any given moment, since they do not have comprehensive knowledge of what is hidden in the spirits of those who are listening. This is why people feel as though the Envoys know what is in their spirit; they find that the Envoys talk to them about the things they are interested in, so that their words are appropriate to each person and their particular field of interest. This comes about as a result of the Godly Revelation, Which allows them to have such an effect on people’s spirits.

As for the believers, they find that the Envoys’ speech reminds them of the Godly Favor they have witnessed, or of the kingdom of heaven and earth. As a result their belief grows and they increasingly submit to God. However, while the believers deem the words of the Envoys to be good omens, the unbelievers and hypocrites consider all of the Envoys’ words as warnings to them.

When the believer reads the Qur’an, they see good omens therein. When the unbeliever reads the Qur’an, they find that it prevents them from fulfilling their earthly wishes and actions. When some of the stories of Prophets are mentioned to the believer, they recognize their perfection and find them always and ever to be the pioneers in every noble quality. Meanwhile, the unbeliever or hypocrite interprets their sayings and actions as defects. For example, when the Almighty says:

“David, We have made you a successor in the land. Rule with justice among people and do not yield to inclination...”,

120

the unbeliever will construe this inclination as a sexual one, whereas the believer will consider it as Godly Passion and passionate love for God’s Presence and for His Beauty and Majesty, and this is the true interpretation.

121

Furthermore, occasionally God wanted to put an end to one of the negative pre-Islamic habits, such as the habit of adopting children. In this case He chose the Envoy Mohammad (cpth) to fulfill this function and ordered him to marry Zeinab, who had been divorced from his adopted son, Zaid. The chaste and noble Envoy was embarrassed to break with such a deep-rooted habit, and was afraid lest people’s tongues would start to talk about him in an evil way because of breaching this habit. Your Provider then wanted to reveal the embarrassment the noble Envoy (cpth) had hidden, and with that, the sick-hearted ones set out to accuse the chaste Envoy of loving Zeinab, and began to fabricate devilish tales about the event, for which no sanction had been revealed by Al’lah.

122

It is the same concerning the Prophet masters Joseph, Solomon, and Job (peace is through them).

There is another point, which is no less than this in terms of its evil. This is to consider human beings’ actions to be nothing more than a fate that has been predetermined by Al’lah. This is a denial that free will and choice are ours, instead ascribing it to Al’lah. Through such a claim, people are incited to commit sin. Furthermore, when some people enter onto the subject of God’s Self, they describe Him as a God Who is encompassed by His material throne and is extremely far from us. They claim that on Doomsday, He will be sitting on His Throne, which is being carried by the angels. As for His Hand, His Eye, and His Face, those who shun have strange conceptions and images of them, all of which are completely removed from what He means by them.

Concerning His Attributes, some people interpret them in a way that renders them contrary to the qualities of absolute perfection that He (glory to Him) possesses, and which are contained in each of His Names. Therefore, those whose hearts contain only sickness find nothing in their reading of the Qur’an except tales and examples, without any bond joining them together, and without any agreement or consistency among them. This is because the spirit of anyone who turns away from Al’lah has acquired nothing from Him

-

neither science nor purity, neither perfection nor facts

-

except what has been attained in Al-Azal world. Most of this meagre scientific knowledge has already been effaced by committing sin. As a result, when such an unbeliever reads the Qur’an, they will doubt, or even deny.

God says:

“Why then do they not have faith, or prostrate themselves when the Qur’an is read to them? Although the unbelievers deny it, Al’lah knows best what their spirits contain.”

123

The cause of the lack of reverence for Al’lah’s Book and the denial of its lofty and sublime meanings is the falsehood contained in their spirits. This denial or suspicion is what was displayed earlier by the Israeli scholars, because their spirits had been covered with falsehood as a result of their disbelief, so that their hearts became as hard as rock or even harder. The high meaning of the Torah was then hidden from them, and when they found nothing in their scripture, they abandoned it. They set out to write a religion of their own for people, claiming that it came from Al’lah, although it did not. This is exactly the same as what some Muslims have done by giving up the Qur’an and focusing on superstitions for which Al’lah revealed no sanction.

Most people think that if they learn some of the Holy Qur’an and a lot of the Prophetic sayings and doctrinal writings (opinions of jurists) by heart, they shall become true believers. Although it is good to do this, it is not enough to make anyone become a scholar or a true believer. A real scholar is someone who can really witness and taste what they have memorized, because then, when the Godly Compassion or the Godly Justice is mentioned, they will have tasted a share of it. In other words, a person must seek to touch and ascertain the reality and the meaning of the speech they utter, witnessing its facts rather than only believing in the mere utterance. Any word in itself is a symbol of the meaning; it is not the meaning itself. For instance, when we view one of the oceans on a map, the fact that it has been drawn does not mean that this is the ocean itself, because if you have not seen the sea, your image of it will surely be imperfect. That is to say, your image will be restricted by the limits of the map you have seen or drawn. Thus, if you have not realized the Godly Omnipotence, your uttering of the word ‘Omnipotent’ will be considered valueless if this word will soon slip away as soon as you see a sword pointed at you.

If you had only sensed the Omnipotence, or realized that Al’lah is the Subduer of His creation (ibad), knowing scientifically that He arranges matters within a straight path, then you would never be afraid of any sword that is aimed at you once you have become straight in your life.

Indeed, faith based on polytheism is the cause of denial and doubt. Al’lah says:

“The greater part of them believe in God yet worship other gods besides Him.”

124

Such polytheistic faith comes as a result of people’s neglect of the Godly Laws, which were put in place by the Provider of the world to be a path that leads to Him so that one can believe in Him correctly and soundly. The best way is that which was followed by the Envoys (ptt), and to which we have been directed by Al’lah’s Words:

“Those were the men whom Al’lah guided. Follow then their guidance. Say

(Mohammad)

: I demand of you no recompense for this. It is but a reminder to all the worlds.”

125

He also says:

“There is a good example in God’s Envoy for those who look to Al’lah and the Last Day, and who always remember Al’lah.”

126

If we refer to the Envoy’s conduct before and during his mission, and if we then carefully consider the meaning of the stories God told us about His noble Envoys, and if we contemplate how the first verses of the Qur’an which were revealed in Mecca urge us to think deeply about God’s universal signs (which were made by the Grand God Himself, such as the stars, the sun and the moon), and if we then adopt the path that was adopted by our father Abraham (pth) in order to be true believers: if we follow these steps, we will gain ripe fruit and a faith with deep roots, established upon a firm and solid basis.

However, instead of this, some of our scholars set to filling the brains of students with premature information that is of no use, and which, in fact, is even of more damage than benefit. The knowledge crammed into students’ brains cannot withstand these godless theories, despite their silliness and stupidity. If the kind of knowledge that is taught by the imitating scholars was truly taken from God, the super philosophical theories that have been developed by the contemporary scientists of our wild age would not be able to withstand the critiques of these students; indeed, these philosophies would become a laughing stock. The Almighty Al’lah revealed weighty words to His Envoy that refute falseness, wherever it may be. The Qur’an’s meanings are veiled from people due to the sins that are contained in people’s nature, and because of the scholars’ claim that the interpretation of the Qur’an given by our forefathers forbids any interpretive judgment at a later stage. They believe that only our forefathers understood this religion, and so any new understanding from those who came after them will not surpass their understanding, or even approach its rank. In this way they created auras of glory around their books. With that claim, they deprived people of interpretive judgment and prevented them from using the gift of thought, except within the limits falsely set for them by our forefathers.

God says:

“When it is said to them: ‘follow what Al’lah has revealed’, they reply: ‘we will follow what we found in our fathers’ practice,’ even though their fathers realized nothing and refused guidance.”

127

This was how they debarred people from the path of Al’lah. Nobody tried to challenge their falsity or show them proof that would confute them and defeat their falsity.

Although these interpolated impudences made many Muslims leave their religion, the strangest thing is that the imitating scholars created an aura of veneration around ancient books and unsound proofs, thus making them into a substitute for the Holy Qur’an. They froze thinking and closed the door of interpretative judgment. Moreover, a group of them turned their back on the Book of God and charged the Envoys and the Prophets of God with enormity, by telling stories of them that were filled with depravity and meanness (far be it from them).

How can we believe some of the things which are mentioned in their books, especially their descriptions of the noble Envoys, imputing them with disgraceful qualities, although these Envoys are at the highest level of God’s creation? How can we accept their shameful allegations in their explanation of the following verse:

“On that day, the dwellers of Paradise shall think of nothing but their bliss”

?

128

We disdain to repeat their wicked and ribald interpolated allegation.

How can we believe that Al’lah is as distant from us as they claim, although He tells us that He is closer to us than the vein of our neck?

How can we believe that ‘Taha’ is the name of a man called ‘Ak’ in the Nabatiyah language?

129

How can we accept their interpretation of the two Fortresses, An-Nas and Al-Falaq, where they claim that Lubaid, the Jew, bewitched the Envoy (cpth)?

Has the devil any authority over God’s first faithful obedient followers (ibad)? The devil himself admitted his inability to have such authority when he said to the Provider of all the worlds:

“Lord, since You have led me astray, I will make them like the life on earth: I will seduce them all, except Your first faithful obedient followers

(ibad)

from among them.”

130

The first of the faithful followers are the Prophets and the Envoys. Can the devil have any effect on our master Mohammad (cpth), who is the master of the first faithful ones?

Moreover, they accused him (cpth) by saying:

“he used to visit a woman called Om Haram Bent Melhan

(who was the wife of Obaida Ibn As-Samet)

and eat there, so when he

(cpth)

visited her one day and ate, she set to lousing his head until he

(cpth)

slept!”

Was Om Haram his wife so that he (cpth) would sleep in her house? Did the Envoy (cpth) not have wives, and did every one of them not have her own special room where he (cpth) slept? Did he need to visit a strange woman? Absolutely not; this story is nothing but an abominable lie and a vicious scheme against the noblest of creatures. Did the Envoy (cpth) have time to go and sleep at this woman’s house? He (cpth) was always engaged in his mission, being charged with the affairs of people and cities which were great and many. Besides, he (cpth) never shook hands with a woman at all. How could they say that Om Haram was lousing his head? I wonder: from what was she lousing his head?! Is this thought about God’s Envoy (cpth) appropriate?

The Envoy (cpth) is the guide, and the one guided by Al’lah. He is far above such allegations, and above any saying that puts him in the wrong. Such sayings make people’s hearts turn away from him (cpth), and make people think bad thoughts about him, and consequently, they will break off communicating with God through him, and their entrance into His Presence through his company will cease.

In many false studies of washing and the major ritual of impurity, they make outrageous statements about the pure wives of the Envoy (cpth), especially about our mother A’isha (God is pleased with her). They claim that she (far be it for her) said:

“When the Prophet

(cpth)

and I were impure, we would wash ourselves from the same basin, and when I was menstruating, he asked me to wrap myself in a loincloth in order for him to copulate with me…”

131

Is this not the saying of a rebellious devil? Those who wish ill for Islam and for the Prophet (cpth) have exploited this nonsense and have employed it as an invective against the blameless Prophet (cpth).

The most cunning thing is that they put justifications and purposes in place for those stories, in order to deceive the common people, despite the fact that these untrue accounts bear no relationship at all to the attributes of the Envoy or those of his pure family.

We will not believe all of the sayings of the forefathers. We will only accept the ones which are correct, and which reveal the perfection of God’s noble Envoys and of His Speech

-

which are firmly connected with each other

-

and which do not describe God with injustice or contradict the supreme Godly Attributes.

That is a glimpse of the creeds of the people of this time. As for their deeds, they are no less ill than their creeds.

The factories that were built by ancient nations are insignificant and beyond compare with the atomic stockpiles and the factories of destructive weapons.

The wangling of weights and measures is only a childish trick in comparison with the juggling of people’s foods and the absorption of their wealth that takes place at the current time.

The tyranny of the old nations is negligible compared to the genocide and the hellish machinery that we see these days. As for people’s clothes, they have become so gauzy that they show what lies beneath them, and it is nudity or semi-nudity that has become the most popular fashion nowadays.

It has become popular for men to become like women and women to become like men today; as a result, adultery has spread across all communities, and some governments have even officially validated perversion.

In a few words, the beliefs and the deeds of humanity in the current age have exceeded the limits of normality, and corruption and dissipation have reached their peak in most nations, while the others are speedily following in the footsteps of those who have gone before them in corruption.

The Almighty God (glory to Him) chose limits, decreed rules and legislated laws for humanity. If they overstepped these rules, exceeded these limits and neglected this legislation, their spirits would be corrupted. Since the corrupted corrupter who is intentionally excessive has no good inside themselves, then the Fire will be their abode

-

it is an evil refuge and end, indeed!

After this clarification, I do not think that the reader will think that humanity will escape destruction. The fact is that people have now moved to the edge of a chasm and are on the verge of a steep slope. They are now immersed in their blindness and the trifling that they have attracted with their abundant worldly desires. The Almighty has cautioned us time and time again in His Holy Book, but the signs and warnings are of no avail for people who do not believe.

God says:

“We have made the Qur’an easy to remember but will any take heed? To Pharaoh’s people came the warnings, but they disbelieved all of Our Signs and We smote them with the scourge of the Mighty One, the All-Powerful. Are your unbelievers better than these Muslims among you? Are you given immunity in the scriptures? Do they say: ‘if we are united together

(all the Arab nations)

we are victorious?’ All gathered together, they shall be defeated, routed and put to flight. The Hour is their appointed time. That Hour shall be more calamitous and more doleful.”

132

The Almighty has revealed the nature of the curse that has afflicted each of the previous nations. For example, He drowned the folk of our master Noah (pth), and did the same with Pharaoh’s people. Thamoud’s people were destroyed by a deafening shout, and ‘Ad’s were destroyed by a howling violent wind.

As for the nations of current days, they will be ruined by a scorching fire which leaves nothing and spares no one.

§§§§§

Anyone who thoroughly studies the problems of this time will return in frustration. They will feel that the evil powers have fixed their roots deep into the ground, and humanity can only correct itself by uprooting those who cause evil and corruption. There is no evil and no error greater than that of those disastrous worldly spoilers who have permeated people’s hearts and made them wretched. People believed that these spoilers would grant them abundant water and a happy life, but the fact is that they only led them to affliction and epidemic, misery and war, the anger of nature, and the madness and perdition of cattle. Humankind will not enjoy happiness unless and until they do away with such corrupters and establish God’s Statute on His Land.

The frustration which we feel is ascribed to many factors, such as the arms race and the heated struggle among the Great Powers for control of the earth, the horrors of scientific progress, and the insufficiency and lack of flexibility of the laws at the time of this great technological intensification.

These reasons, and others, do not lead us to expect a peaceful future. Besides, not much effort is exerted in securing peace, and the results of peace conferences on disarmament or attempts to limit the spread of arms are insignificant. Thus the Great Powers are, as yet, unable to adopt a resolution that will deter the occurrence of disaster.

The disarmament conferences and the efforts made to find peace are blocked by many obstacles, such as:

-Firstly

: a lack of confidence among the conflicting parties who own nuclear and hydrogen bombs, and the mistrust, doubt, and wariness which each party feels towards their opponent.

-Secondly

: the prioritization of national interest and sovereignty over the advantage of humanity as a whole. Conduct at the international level has not yet transcended a focus on national interest, and is limited to the consideration of what is of benefit to one’s own native country. This means that any menace that threatens national sovereignty or that damages the economic, political or security interest of a state will make that state brandish the deadly weapons at its disposal at those who threaten its interests. They do not seem to care that the damage caused by these weapons will not only affect their opponents, but will affect almost all of humanity.

-Thirdly

: the existence of two clashing systems in the world: the western system and the eastern one. A huge mass of humanity stands behind each system, possessing the most ruinous of arms, with which they seek to rule the entire world. Since the heads of each system detest those of the other system, when one of them notices that the other system is becoming dominant, their reaction will be crucial.

-Fourthly:

the wild arms race, both quantitatively and qualitatively, under the pretense: “to secure peace, prepare for war.” This means that if one party was stronger than the other, the latter would hesitate to bring about the calamity of war. According to this theory, the arms race will continue so that neither of the two disputing parties will dare to attack their enemy. This theory indicates a state of permanent alarm and continuous tension among all the members of the human community. Do alarm and tension have no end? If disarmament or the destruction of these armaments is not possible, is war not the only way to find an end to this situation?

This clearly shows that the evil factors that are driving us to war are greater than those driving us towards peace. Furthermore, the originators of corruption are still spreading dangerously, and increasing in depth and currency.

All that makes us conclude that woe is about to befall us at any moment, and disaster is surely coming

-

it is not distant for those who oppose.

However, this affliction is not a decreed fate for us; it will not occur if we change our conduct, in which case the Almighty Al’lah will find a way to save us

-

both as nations and individually

-

from the danger that is crouching on our chests.

God says:

“If only there had been a community

(of all those that were destroyed of old)

that believed and profited by its belief, as did the people of Jonah! When they believed, We drew the torment of shame from them in the life of this world and gave them comfort for a while.”

133

The door of repentance and return to God is always open; it will only be closed when death or destruction occurs.

God says:

“Repentance is not accepted for those who do evil and when death comes to them, say: ‘Now we repent!’ Nor is it accepted for those who die unbelievers. For these We have prepared a woeful scourge.”

134

The Provider of the worlds has named this time of disaster as ‘the Hour’, and wherever the word ‘Hour’ is mentioned in the Qur’an, it bears many meanings. It is the hour in which a person dies, the hour in which resurrection shall occur, or the hour of which we now speak. If we put aside the hour of death, and that of resurrection, and settle on the hour in which the Messiah master Jesus Christ (pth) will return, we shall find that ‘the World War’ or ‘the Coming Nuclear War’ is the name of this purging war:

“Yet the Hour is their appointed time. More calamitous and more bitter shall that Hour be.”

135

This is the hour that will accompany the coming of the Messiah master Jesus Christ (pth), the rescuer of mankind and the Envoy of peace, tranquility and safety, after the time of wearisome worry and wretchedness. Blessed is the one who shall survive, for the Almighty made a promise, saying:

“When Al’lah said: ‘Jesus, I am about to let you sleep and upgrade you. I shall relieve you of the unbelievers and exalt your followers above them until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me you shall all return and I shall judge your disputes’.”

136

That is, when he will come once again, now and very soon, ease is imminent for the believers. The indications preceding his coming have all occurred and been completed by Al’lah’s Leave.

True was the saying of God’s Envoy (cpth) when he said:

“The Hour will never overtake people until two great groups fight in a great battle, though they profess the same claim.”

True also was his saying (cpth):

“the Hour will never come to pass until the worst people prevail.”

This is the hour of destruction for this vicious world, and the crushing of disbelief and its people.

The next nuclear war will be distinguished

-

just like other wars

-

by quickness and surprise. However, this war differs from those that preceded it concerning its aim. In previous wars, the purpose of speed and surprise was to achieve victory, but in this war

-

that is, the war of nuclear and hydrogen

-

the purpose will be to avoid the danger of total ruin and to wipe out the opponent completely, before they have the opportunity to retaliate against their enemy. Therefore, the one who starts the war will use as many of their atomic and hydrogen bombs as possible in the opening minutes of this war

-

as well as their other weapons of mass destruction

-

so as to totally annihilate the enemy and wipe them out of existence. However, the modern early warning systems and the state of full military alertness will not allow the one who starts the war to completely surprise their opponent. Thus this opponent will have the opportunity to retaliate and also exterminate their enemy. No triumph will be achieved in the coming war, but death will be universal and final. Hence it is clear that the next war will be so fast that it will not last more than one hour, and it will overtake people suddenly in their heedlessness.

God says:

“They ask you…”:

“after your revelation

” “…about the Hour…”:

“they ask you about when the Hour will occur, instead of thinking about what you are saying and heeding it.” Since they paid no attention to his words, they asked him this question:

“…when it is to come…”:

when is its occurrence?

“…say: ‘none knows about it except my Provider. He alone will reveal it at the appointed time’…”:

“nobody knows its appointed time; I am nothing more than an Envoy. Although I know nothing about when it will take place, there are indications that precede it,”

“…a frightful hour it shall be…”:

it will be great in its terror. The scourge will smite them from above and from below; fire and earthquakes will leave nothing untouched and spare no one. Do you have knowledge of its horror? Have you prepared yourself to face it? Or do you only ask about when it will take place? If the questioner had thought, they would have recognized the majesty of Al’lah and would not have asked such a question, but would have feared it.

“…both in the heavens and on earth…”:

there shall be terror and calamities that come from both the heavens and the earth. The scourge shall strike them from the earth and from the heavens,

“…it will come without warning…”:

suddenly, when people are not paying attention. However, the affliction will not only affect us in the present life, but also after this life.

“…they will put questions to you as though you have no knowledge of it…”:

“as if you know nothing about it, and you are not aware of it: you want to save them from the scourge, but they want to put you to the test.” This refers to the unbelievers of the Jewish religion who wanted to test the Envoy, as the Hour had been mentioned in their scripture, the Torah.

“…say: ‘none knows about it save Al’lah’…”:

no one has knowledge about the time of its occurrence except Al’lah,

“…‘yet most men are unaware of this’...”:

they know nothing about its terror. People have no knowledge of it, and none of them think of it. God knows best that its appointed time has become very near, as all its indications have manifested themselves. How wretched will be anyone who fails to think about it or prepare themselves for it.

137

In the Prophetic tradition, he (cpth) informed us about the nuclear and hydrogen bomb when he said:

“the Hour will never overtake people until the mountains are removed from their places, and you witness great matters which you have never seen before.”

Since this disaster concerns humanity as a whole, it is incumbent upon us to give a clear conception of it. Later on we will mention, by Al’lah’s Leave, the events that will follow it and on which the fate of humanity depends.

In fact, loving this lowly life is what stands between people and recognition of Al’lah. This destructive, blind, materialist civilization has possessed people’s hearts and minds. Therefore, a return to Al’lah is contingent on the removal of this civilization. Since people will not give up this worldly civilization voluntarily, God is the One Who will uproot it, and will do so at the hands of its creators:

“Those who have gone before them also plotted, but Al’lah smote their edifice at its foundations and its roof fell down upon their heads. His scourge overtook them, whence they did not know.”:

they laid plans, prepared tricks, and instigated arrangements to fight against the truth, but Al’lah destroyed their edifice at its base so that what they had made tumbled down upon their heads and their own bombs struck them. They plotted to turn people away from the truth, but Al’lah brought the scourge down upon them, and they injured themselves with the same knife they had sharpened in order to hurt others. Their evil turned against them:

“Then He will disgrace them on the Day of Resurrection…”

138

Humanity has never and will never pass through a disaster as harsh as this catastrophe. None shall survive, except for the believer, or the one with the capacity for belief. As for underground bunkers, they will avail people nothing against the decree of Al’lah if He wills their destruction, and the logic of this war affirms that. Atomic radiation, pollution, the decomposition of the dead, and earthquakes will prevent those who were not terminated by the first blow from staying alive once they leave their safe havens, and we do not know what may emerge from below ground and attack them.

Humans cannot continue to live underground for a long time. Suppose their bunker was provided with everything necessary. Nonetheless, life would become impossible in such a place, for everything would be still and motionless, and nothing would be heard except the groaning of the wind and a horrible silence. There would be no family, no home, and no children, as everything would have returned to ashes.

We wonder about and try to imagine the situation of a person who leaves their haven after some time has passed! Apart from the terrible atomic dust and its poisonous effects, surely their spiritual situation would deteriorate to the point of craziness or emotional and mental breakdown, and those people who hope to reestablish civilization once again would know that such a restoration is most improbable and no more than fantasy.

Indeed, destruction will occur, proportional to the degree of disbelief and perversity; accordingly, the regions of the camps of both West and East will become desolate wastelands, and the corpses of their people shall be wood for the fire and then ashes, scattered by the wind. You shall find that not one of them is still alive, or hear so much as a whisper from them.

As for the Middle East region in particular, which is the cradle of Prophets, it will suffer a smaller share of destruction than other areas. However, this does not mean that some aspects of civilization will remain there. This will be impossible, for this area will experience

-

like other regions

-

severe famines and earthquakes, and will be the scene of devastating wars. However, nuclear and hydrogen bombs will not be used in this region. Only a few of its people shall escape after the war has driven out all of their spiritual diseases, causing them to be pure once again. This purification will be a result of their decision to resort to Al’lah, inspired by their great suffering, and by the pain, fear, and hunger they shall face.

Therefore, the only safe haven we should prepare is to have recourse to Al’lah from this moment, for resorting to Him will be of no use when the Hour arrives at the door, and none but Al’lah can dispel its dread. We must repent, ready ourselves and take precautions before the day arrives, when prayers will avail nothing.

Consider the fate of the nations that have gone before!

“We have destroyed many a sinful nation…”:

like you,

“…and replaced them with other men.”:

think of the people of days gone by! Where are they now? What did their states produce for them? Like them, you will be destroyed, if you do not repent and return to the right path: this is a general threat directed at each perverted person. If we recognize the truth only in our thoughts we will profit nothing. It is necessary to fully realize it and with that, we will witness reality with the eye of our heart.

“And when they felt Our Might…”:

when the scourge smote them,

“…they fled”:

from their countries; they raced to rid themselves of this scourge, but where could they have found refuge when the quakes occurred? At the time of your death, you will be asked about praying, fasting, and pilgrimage. Everything has an external form and an internal reality; reality avails nothing without form, and form avails nothing without reality: it is necessary to gather them together. Any person who confines themselves only to forms will avail themselves nothing.

“Do not run away…”:

like those who came before, for you will be destroyed. We said to them before on the tongues of their Envoys:

“do not run away tomorrow, when affliction comes,” “…and return to your comforts…”:

do not plant evil in the spirits of humanity. Think: are your deeds good and logical?

“…and your dwellings…”:

in which you live, and the dwellings of lowness and evil in which your spirits also abide. Look at these cities! Who has ruled over them? Who has dwelled in them? Where are the people who lived before you? Shall you remain on this earth forever?

“…so that you may…”:

know, if you think, and realize that after this life you will certainly

“…be questioned.”:

you may know why you have been created and correct your conduct, and then you will ascertain that you will be questioned about everything and about every one of your actions. Otherwise this questioning will not come into your mind.

“They said: ‘woe to us’…”:

when the scourge had been brought down upon them,

“…‘we have done wrong’.”:

but what will these words avail when affliction and destruction have come?!

“And they kept following that way…”:

of opposing the truth and denying the Envoys,

“…until We mowed them down and left them outside.”:

if we continue to be attached to the lower life, we will not think of death, and this failure is what will cause us to persist in denying the truth.

“It was not in sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them.”

139

: was it to find a pastime? Think, you human, of the heavens, the earth, and the mountains: were they created for nothing? All of them were created for your happiness. Did He create the world for sport? Will you not think about why this universe was created by Al’lah? He created you so you must be humane.

Nobody shall escape from this horrible event except the believer and the one who is capable of true faith. At this Hour, every evildoer will surely die, and the truth will be revealed to those who are capable of true belief from the tongue of our master Jesus Christ (pth) or his followers. Then, if such a person believes truly and is rightly guided, and if they confess the Good Godly Guidance, they will spend a pleasant life here, and in the hereafter, they will be one of those who are worthy to achieve God’s Gifts in Paradise. But if they do not; they will be among the ones who are destroyed.

Indeed, this affliction will never befall the doer of good because of the guilt of the evildoer; the proverb which says that

“mercy is specific whereas affliction is general”

is surely wrong, because the whole of the Noble Qur’an, which contains irrefutable proof, disagrees with this claim. Instead it reveals that mercy is apportioned, and so it is with affliction.

Concerning the previous nations which were ruined, the Almighty showed us that He delivered the believers among them when He says:

“And when Our judgment came to pass, We delivered Hud through Our Mercy, together with those who shared his faith. We delivered them from a woeful scourge.”

140

“And when Our judgment came to pass, We delivered Sa’leh through Our Mercy from the ignominy of that day, together with those who shared his faith. Mighty is your Provider and All-Peerless.”

141

The case with the people of Midian and the people of Lot was similar, as revealed in other verses. These are unchangeable rules and laws which apply to the individual as well as the group. The Almighty promised that He will definitely rescue the true believers when disaster befalls their people. He says:

“…similarly, it is true that We should save the believers.”

142

As regards the noble verse:

“Guard yourselves against temptation, the chastisement of which will not befall only the wrongdoers among you. Know that Al’lah’s punishment is stern...”

143

, it indicates those who are able to fight against temptation, yet lag behind and fail to do so. They will inevitably be inflicted with the same thing which befalls those who aroused temptation, because when they do not interdict temptation it means that they accept it. However, when temptation spreads and dangerously increases, and exceeds the level at which it can be resisted by believers, then the believer is responsible only for themselves, and for anyone they can guide, and for those over whom they have authority.

144

The Almighty revealed the horror of this Hour to us, and demonstrated that safety at this time will not be attained except through piety. This is the true faith, and is based on witnessing through the Godly Light, as it is impossible for traditional faith to encourage the believer in the face of such calamity. Al’lah says:

“Oh, oblivious men! See by the Light of your Provider, for the catastrophe of the Hour will be terrible indeed. On the day you view this catastrophe, every suckling mother shall forsake her infant, every overloaded spirit shall cast down its burden, and you shall see mankind reeling like drunkards although they are not drunk, but because of Al’lah’s severe torment.”

145

This verse does not indicate Doomsday as some people believe, because the desires that burden the spirit

-

such as women or men, money, prestige, buildings, cars, clothes, and the like

146

-

would have been entirely laid down at the hour of death. On Doomsday there will be no burden, no suckling infants, and no nursing mother. No evil intention will remain inside the human spirit on that day; on the contrary, they will wish to be completely far from having it. As for the burdens of the spirit

-

and indeed, everything that may take up its attentio

147

before the occurrence of the Hour

-

they will continue to exist within, until the spirit is face to face with the horrible events of the Hour. At this point it will promptly cast its burdens aside, and even the suckling mother will forget her infant. We know how great the sympathy of a mother is towards her children. However, at this moment, she will forsake them all! Such awful events will take place soon in this world, when horrible earthquakes will occur, and no concern will settle inside the spirit except the wish to be protected from the intensity of the calamity. At this point, a person will forget everything except the danger that surrounds them,

“…and you shall see mankind reeling like drunkards…”:

the horror makes them abandon everything,

“…although they are not drunk…”:

although they did not drink wine, this torture has already made them act as though they are drunk, for they are distracted from everything,

“…but because of Al’lah’s severe torment”:

indeed, if Al’lah the Almighty describes this day and its torture with harshness, we wonder: how then will it be?!

The hour of destruction has been mentioned in the Gospel too; we shall refer to this at the proper time.

This is not odd, for our master Messiah Jesus Christ (pth) is an indication of the Hour, and is the focus of it, and is the man who has been ordered to raise up the word of truth on the earth, from the time the Hour occurs until Doomsday, with the support of Al’lah, the Almighty. However, similarly to the Muslims, the Christians have understood that the Hour of the coming of the Messiah is Doomsday

-

or that the Christ will appear in spirit, soaring above the people, to bring peace to the world, but not to do so physically or in body.

Thus we ask: what is the use of the Envoy’s arrival on Doomsday? Will this happen through an unseen spirit? Will not the period of examination have ended on Doomsday?! Will people not be waiting for the delivery of the book of their ‘written deeds’ in this worldly life? They will receive this with their right hand (an indication of their good deeds) or their left hand (for their wrongful deeds). What use will advice and sermons be at this time?! Has not the veil been uncovered?! Has not the sight become so keen?

Indications of the Hour

Al’lah says:

“Your Provider will not destroy a nation without just cause and due warning.”

148

God (glory to Him) does not smite people with a scourge without prior warning. Indeed, out of His Compassion, He sent forth an Envoy to His creation (ibad) to discourage them from disbelief and from going astray, and to warn them that if they do not repent, they will end up in the Fire that is prepared for the unbelievers.

God says:

“Your Provider never destroys the nations until He has sent Envoys to their capital cities proclaiming Our Revelations to them; We destroy them only because they sin.”

149

If they stop the injustice that they do to themselves, and if they hold their spirits back from following their whims, then they will find that Al’lah is Forgiving and Merciful, for He changes their sins into good deeds, and spares them the scourge of disgrace:

“If only there had been a community

(of all those that were destroyed of old)

that believed and profited by its belief as did the folk of Jonah! When they believed, We drew the torment of shame from them in the life of this world and gave them comfort for a while.”

150

However, if they disobey the Commandment of their Provider and insist on disbelief, then Al’lah will make them taste of the lightest chastisement before the greatest chastisement so that they may repent and return. Alternatively, He will afflict them with distress and calamity, bewildering them with dissent in order to make them taste each other’s tyranny. He may also stamp them with ignominy and humbleness, or let them feel hunger, fear, anxiety, or other kinds of torment so that, through these disasters and remedies, they may awaken from their inadvertence. However, if they do not submit to Al’lah’s Command, and do not take warning from all the calamities that are now taking place around the world

-

such as hurricanes, equatorial storms, earthquakes, volcanoes, draught in some regions and deluges in others, floods like the tsunami, and many others throughout the land, as well as destructive wars, incurable diseases that attack humans and cattle like Mad Cow disease, Bird Flu, Sheep Plague, and the perishing of camels and she-camels, and so forth

-

if they do not take note of this, then Al’lah will smite them with the scourge of a woeful day:

“Such was the scourge which your Provider visited upon the sinful nations. His punishment is stern and sore.”

151

Therefore, through the words of His Envoy (cpth), the Almighty has informed us of the indications and the signs that precede this Hour, so that we may correct our conduct and return to the path of goodness. The Rising of the Sun in the West and the Separation of the Moon

The sun and the moon indicate Al’lah’s movement towards a particular aim within a definite period of time. They never change in their orbits, and any alteration that may occur in their order would be followed by a change in the cosmic discipline as a whole. Therefore, if we were to accept that the sun may rise in the west, this would mean that the earth had started to rotate in the reverse of its original direction. Consequently, the night would come before the day. Such a matter is, however, impossible, as Al’lah has stated in a clear verse:

“The sun is not allowed to overtake the moon, nor does the night outpace the day. Each runs in its own orbit.”

172

Therefore, this indication does not refer to the rise of the flaming celestial body in the morning and its setting in the evening. Rather, the rising of the sun here has a figurative meaning.

Besides, the Almighty has told us that His Envoy (cpth) is a shining lamp, and the lamp is the sun; He says:

“Oh, Prophet! We have sent you forth to bear witness, to bear good news and to warn others; We have sent you as one who shall call people to Al’lah by His Leave and guide them like a shining lamp.”

173

We can see that he (cpth) was the sun of the Prophets, a mercy for all the worlds, and Al’lah’s Light by which a part of Al’lah’s Attributes can be witnessed. Hence, the word ‘lamp’ here has a figurative meaning so as to demonstrate the reality of God’s Envoy (cpth). He reveals that which is incomprehensible and discloses that which has gone before.

Moreover, our master Joseph (pth) witnessed his father, his mother, and his brothers as a sun, a moon, and planets in his dream.

As for the sun, which is our subject, Dhul-Qarnain (pth) found that it was setting on people who were so ignorant and had so little civilization that their knowledge was limited. They believed that the sun existed only to give them heat. However, was it then possible that this huge and magnificent sun, lying in the sky, could set in a plot of the earth? Furthermore, if it was in the sky, how could he find a people with it? What would happen if the sun approached the earth and departed from its scientifically charted orbit? Would the earth not vaporize and perish?

God says:

“Until, when he

(Dhul-Qarnain)

reached the setting of the sun, he found it setting upon people with neither material civilization nor divine knowledge…”

174

“…he found it setting upon people with neither material civilization nor divine knowledge…”:

it was helpful that these people knew nothing of the sun apart from its heat. Dhul-Qarnain found a sun that was hanging in the sky above a group of people over whom civilization had never spread. They were ignorant nations, without religion and without worldly pleasures.

They were artless and entirely unacquainted with either culture or civilization.

Their spirits were clear, and that was why they accepted the truth. This clarity of their spirits allowed them to discern and witness reality.

They then became people of righteousness and the supporters of righteousness; they gave their assistance to the causes of Al’lah, and promoted justice all over the world.

As for the people of the neighboring region: their share of civilization and culture was rather better than on the former ground. Nonetheless, they also responded to our master Dhul-Qarnain (pth) and spread Islam across the whole world. These people were similar to the followers of the great master Jesus Christ (pth). The Almighty says that they shall be above the unbelievers until the Day of Resurrection, as they are the rightly guided guides and humane people. They carry on finding amiability in their Provider, so that every being in creation likes their company.

Thus the intended meaning of ‘the rising of the sun in the west’ is the emergence of civilization and brilliant sciences in the west (that is, from the place where the sun sets) rather than the east, from whence came the sun of the Prophet (cpth), the shining lamp.

The civilization of this age has ascended from the west and spread throughout the world, like the rays of the sun. This civilization has left the trace of its rays everywhere and has placed its stamp on everyone. This civilization, which prevails across the depth and breadth of the world, has overwhelmed people’s hearts and minds, and is keeping their hearts away from the real source of light. It has left them living anxiously in deep darkness. As a result of its ability to send out heat and light with its rays (in the form of electricity, for example), it has been able to dazzle the unbelievers, whereas in actual fact, it has only pushed them further into darkness, for they do not see. This blindness in people’s hearts has led them to take only worldly benefits from this civilization, and these benefits are not based on belief.

Hence we can say that the rising of the sun in the west and the separation of the moon are figurative expressions indicating the major signs of the Hour. Moreover, the beginning of the noble verse in the Holy Qur’an, Fortress 54, Al-Qamar (The Moon) is relevant here, and it states:

“The Hour is drawing near, and the moon has dissociated.”

This verse is evidence of this meaning and shows clearly that the separation of the moon is a matter that denotes the imminent occurrence of the Hour; it is not a miracle bestowed on our master Mohammad (cpth) as has been posited. This meaning is also confirmed by the following:
