that will talk to them. Truly, men have no more certain faith then in Our Revelations.”

203

In the last verse of the three noble verses above, God (praise is to Him) has stipulated that the occurrence of total destruction will come only after the emergence of a ground crawler; when that crawler appears, the scourge will have become an irrevocable judgment and will merely be waiting to be achieved. As regards the time of its occurrence, this remains unknown, for it will overtake us suddenly. Only Al’lah has knowledge of that which is hidden, so He alone will reveal this at the appointed time. Nevertheless, the indications are all in evidence, which surely warn of the imminent occurrence of this time, and we should take this into consideration.

The preceding verses clarify which kinds of people will be punished, including those whose sight has been blinded, whose ears have been deafened, and whose hearts have been put to death by their love of this lower life. These people will not be guided by anyone, as they have shunned the truth and turned their faces toward falsehood. Neither will Al’lah guide them, because they have surrendered themselves to their low desires, and these desires have come to be like gods that are steering them. By contrast, those who believe in Al’lah’s Signs

-

and who submit to Him rather than their own desires

-

are the ones who listen to the truth.

In the current time, all people have given free rein to their desires and turned wholly towards this worldly life, pouncing upon it. This means that repentance and returning to Al’lah have become almost impossible. As a result, most people deserve to be destroyed. The destructive hurricanes, successive earthquakes, floods, droughts, locusts, and deadly diseases of bird, camel, and cow are merely afflictions which precede the impending total destruction. Such a series of awful disasters has not been seen for thousands of years and hundreds of generations.

Indeed, we have come to a point where perishing would be a kind of mercy for the kinds of people who are attached to this lower, worldly life. If they were to remain alive, they would only cause more damage to themselves and to others. Thus, it is out of His Mercy that God will overtake them suddenly and harshly, lest they commit more sins and thereby deserve more torment in Hell.

In the previous noble verse God did not say that He would create a crawler; rather the Almighty said:

“When they follow the devil’s call, We shall bring from the earth a crawler that will talk to them…”

Beyond bringing it forth, He (praise is to Him) did not say that the purpose of the crawler was to show people a miracle; indeed, as we have already discussed, He stopped sending signs at the time of our master Mohammad (cpth), since they had been of no avail. God says:

“Nothing hinders Us from giving signs except that the ancients disbelieved them. To Thamoud We gave the she-camel as a visible sign, yet they oppressed themselves with it. We give signs only by way of warning.”

204

In this noble verse, it is not an accident that God mentions the she-camel in particular, as one miracle of the many that He gave to His noble Envoys who were sent forth before our master Mohammad (cpth). He has a reason for naming this particular sign rather than any other. It is a certain indication that prevents people from thinking that the crawler that is to be brought forth from the earth is an animal. It stops them from assuming that the purpose of its emergence is for them to be shown a miracle. Indeed, Al’lah has another aim, unrelated to miracles. Moreover, the emergence of a crawler from the earth cannot be considered to be a miracle. It would even be illogical for it to be a miracle when it is considered that Al’lah previously sent a similar miracle which was not believed.

The word ‘crawler’ (which in Arabic is ‘dabbah’) means ‘everything that can creep or crawl on land.’ It primarily refers to that which can be mounted or ridden. Thus, the word ‘dabbabah’, which is a combat machine or tank, is derived from the verb ‘dabba’ in Arabic, and was named as such because it crawls along upon the land. Accordingly, the word ‘dabbah’ does not refer exclusively to animals, but also to anything else that can crawl across the land.

The Almighty has informed us that the she-camel of our master Sa’leh (pth) was Al’lah’s Own She-camel (and her share of water was assigned to her by His Command). That she-camel was a living creature of flesh, blood and soul. By contrast, it is not stated that the crawler that is to be brought forth from the earth will be a living being. Even the words

“…will talk to them…”

are no proof, since many machines can also talk to people, such as recorders, televisions, radios, and so forth.

Is it not true that he (cpth) spoke to us about the car, describing it to us thus:

“There will be temptations after me that rest at their doors, which are similar to camels when they kneel down. They will give nothing to anyone but take from their faith.”

?

205

A camel is used for transporting people and objects and for traveling, and a camel kneels down and stays in the place where its owner is resting. Likewise, a car offers the same services and also rests in front of the home of its owner.

He (cpth) described it more accurately than this, saying:

“Fire will be sent out to the people of the East and crush them into the West. It will stay with them wherever they pass their night or rest during the day. It will be received by those among them who failed or fell behind, and it will carry them like a broken camel.”

206

That refers to the car, which was manufactured by people in the West, who have used it to disseminate their education and their civilized devices all around the world. Consequently, the East has turned its face toward them and is quaffing from the stagnant spring of their civilization.

The word ‘fire’ here refers to the fire brought about by the pistons in the petrol combustion engine, and its reality is greater than that. The Hadith says:

“...It

(the fire)

will stay with them wherever they pass their night or rest during the day…”,

meaning that wherever the owner of the car may sleep or rest be it by night or by day, their car will remain with them, in front of their home or in front of their hotel. This is its internal description, and he also (cpth) described it externally to his noble companions, saying that even if you follow it, you cannot overtake it, but it can overtake you.

This is one of the Prophet’s prophecies, and they are never wrong. He (cpth) said:

“The last people of this nation will come to the mosques mounted on cushions

(riding cars)

. The women among them will be dressed but undressed, with their hair looking like the humps of lean camels. Keep yourselves away from them, as they are far from Al’lah.”

207

He (cpth) also spoke to people about planes, saying:

“A fire will come to you which is now extinguished. It afflicts people with a painful scourge, consumes funds and spirits, and goes around the world within eight days. It flies like the clouds or the wind. It is hotter by night than by day, and creates a boom between the heavens and the earth like a peal of thunder. It is closer to the heads of creatures than God’s beautiful Revelation

(as seen by true faithful hearts)

.”

208

“…It afflicts people with a painful scourge, consumes funds and spirits…”:

it is well known that military air forces have wide-ranging destructive power.

“…It is hotter by night than by day…”:

as the darkness of the night hides military planes and protects them from being hit by antiaircraft guns, they succeed in carrying out their sudden bombings of cities and garrisons by night.

The quote also refers to the systems of air-conditioning and temperature modification that are installed inside aircraft.

“…It flies like the clouds or the wind. It is hotter by night than by day, and creates a boom between the heavens and the earth like a peal of thunder. It is closer to the heads of creatures than God’s beautiful Revelation

(as seen by true faithful hearts)

.”

He (cpth) indicates the weakness of people’s faith in the current time, for they think that this plane has power and strength. They are forgetting that there is no power or strength except through God, the Owner of the greatest Revelation.

Until now, nothing has been brought from the earth that then crawled upon it except for cars, tanks, trains, and so forth. The composite materials used to make these devices were taken from iron mines in the ground. These crawlers then talked to people through the radios or wireless sets which were placed inside them.

It is said that this crawler will face the East, send a penetrating cry in that direction, and confront the West, sending out another piercing cry in that direction. It will also be like this with regard to the north and the south. This is a reference to the high speed of cars: as soon as one hears the sound of a car’s horn, even from far away, the same car passes by your side in no time at all. The car’s great speed cannot be compared with the speed of the horse, which was used by people in the past before the car was invented. A car’s speed, as we know, is much faster than the speed of a horse.

This saying is also applied to car radios and car phones, for their sound passes through the diameter of the earth. Moreover, this crawler carries with it the donkey of the Antichrist: the radio. This device

-

whether it is mobile or otherwise

-

transmits the sayings of charlatans to people, and these broadcasts can change truth into falsehood or vice versa. The radio has the power to make people hear news which is mostly false and deceptive, with rare exceptions: the Hadith says:

“The ear of the Antichrist’s donkey shades seventy thousand people.”

209

Also relevant are the following words of the Envoy (cpth):

“The length of the tail of the Antichrist’s donkey varies between 40 and 70 cubits, and one hair in it sings”:

this refers to the dial which is used to move from one radio station to another. Also take note of his noble words:

“…and one hair in it sings”,

which means that whenever you move the pointer by the breadth of a hair, the programms of a different station are transmitted. He (cpth) also said of the radio

-

the Antichrist’s donkey

-

that:

“It will enter no home but it will corrupt it…”

meaning that it corrupts the spirits of its listeners because of the endless sexual, depraved songs it broadcasts,

“…and it will enter no store but it will ruin it”:

that is, it corrupts the hearts of the owners of shops who will incline to amusement and impudence because of it, so that they will seek to attain their desires by obtaining profits that exceed the human limit.

In any case, the radio is now a matter of history, and is unimportant when compared with the more advanced technologies that followed it, such as television, satellite, video, computers and the internet.

The Hour shall not overtake people until

“…people talk to the tassels of their lashes and their shoestrings, and their thighs inform them of what their households have done after them.”

210

‘The tassel of the lash’ can be taken to mean the wireless set, for example, as used by traffic police. When using the telephone, you hold the receiver while the wire dangles from it. This correlates with the shoe, as regards both the outward appearance and the color. Thus the Envoy (cpth) used the phrase ‘shoestring’ to indicate the telephone wire, since this device and the sole of an up-turned shoe are quite similar.

“…and their thighs inform them of what their households have done after them”:

he (cpth) is indicating mobile telephones and their leather-cases, which are fixed onto a belt or put into the pocket of a pair of trousers on the upper part of the thigh. This also refers to the surveillance set that some people may install in their homes or work places, and which is attached, in some way, to the wireless telephone.

In fact, when this crawler first appeared at the beginning of the last century, people were deaf to the truth because of the technological revolution. This revolution produced a number of enticements that caused people to believe in the gods of science and technology instead of following the signs of Al’lah. This was how they turned their faces towards the sun of the West.

Although this is a historical piece of research extending only as far as the present, it serves as a witness certifying the indications of the Hour. This is the time when our master Jesus Christ, the Messiah, will come, either during or immediately after the purging World War. God told him (pth) that

“…‘I shall purge you of the unbelievers’…”:

this verse is a promise from Al’lah, the Almighty, to our master Jesus (pth). The promise is that He will purge him of any unbelievers insisting on disbelief, for He will exalt him above the world, along with his followers, when he comes once again. This will continue until the Day of Resurrection.

“…and exalt your followers above them until the Day of Resurrection…”

211

That time will come after his expected appearance, which is imminent in the immediate future, as the indications of his appearance (pth) have all manifested themselves.

The Ornament of the Earth

The Almighty says:

“The prime example of this lower life is the rain which We drop from the sky. It mingles with the crops of the earth which sustain humanity and cattle and then, when the earth is completely adorned and luxuriantly bedecked, and its people think that they can master it, down comes Our Scourge upon it, by night or in broad daylight. The Scourge lays it to waste as if it had not blossomed the day before. Thus, for people who think, We make plain Our Revelations.”

212

Indeed, the earth was entirely ornamented when villages and cities became adorned with colorful electric lights, and the earth was embellished with towering, bedecked buildings and comfortable furniture.

Moreover, shops and exhibitions were established on the edges of streets. Thereafter, women would walk within society outside of their homes, beautifully adorned, looking highly seductive. This habit utterly neglects religious propriety, shyness, and modesty. Women also began to imitate men in their dress.

Furthermore, men also started to imitate women in lengthening their hair, growing sideburns, and wearing colorful clothes. The honorable Envoy Mohammad (cpth) has illustrated one of the signs that will precede the Hour of utter destruction: namely, that women will be seen scantily clad, inclining towards and exciting the desire for fornication. They will also style their hair over their heads like the humps of skinny camels (the style known as ‘high dike’). Therefore you should keep away from them, for they are really cursed.

Regarding these signs, he also said that

“…when women will imitate men and men will imitate women.”

213

Moreover, he said that

“…to see the unshod and bare ‘uncivil’ shepherds elongating their buildings.”

214

The ornamentation was not limited to amusement centers found in markets, but rather extended to include temples too. Now we can see that they have been made into antiquarian museums that are visited both by believers and unbelievers; they no longer fulfill their intended purpose, which is the worship of Al’lah and the arranging of matters to the advantage of Muslims. This is also one of the marks that indicate the nearness of the occurrence of the Hour.

Indeed, the sun of material civilization has been in the ascent, and the sciences, especially technology, have been advancing in wide strides since the dawn of the last century. Consequently, this lower life has been decked out in its most beautiful and brilliant garb. How then can its masters be believers, when they aim to control nature just as they think they can control the earth?! Al’lah says:

“…and its people think that they can master it…”

If humanity were to reach such a point, God says:

“…down comes Our Scourge upon it, by night or in broad daylight…”:

that is, a general affliction will befall the eastern countries at night and the ones in the western hemisphere during the day.

In Az-Zukhruf Fortress, the Almighty told us in detail how He would use the earth for people should they become oblivious and, as one nation, limit their destination to the confines of this world and its riches. They should be like a united nation that is heading for the life of the hereafter and its bliss, to which this lower life will be forcibly made to yield, in accordance with the Almighty’s Will. He says:

“When all humanity becomes a single nation of unbelievers, We shall show compassion to those who deny Us, in the form of dwellings with silver roofs and lifts which they scale, with many doors for their rooms and magnificent beds on which to recline, and much ornament. Nevertheless, all of this is merely worldly pleasure, whereas your Provider favors those who see the pleasures of the hereafter by His Light.”

215

By the statement

“…dwellings with silver roofs…”,

Al’lah is referring to what we now find by way of decoration on wonderfully created ceilings with their charming silvery colors.

“…lifts…”

are the elevators in buildings and

“…which they scale”

means ‘ascend.’

“…with many doors for their rooms…”:

in Arabic, houses are rooms, whereas homes are flats. In classic Arabic homes, a room has a single door, while in modern buildings, it has many. For example, a modern home may have one door for the balcony, another for the reception room, another for the kitchen, and so forth.

“…and magnificent beds…”:

that is, the luxurious and stately beds of modern furniture,

“…and much ornament…”:

those wonderful decorations of high cost which have made humanity completely forget the lofty and everlasting life of Paradise.

Indeed, Al’lah has sent many warnings and all kinds of torment to the world, such as wars and the like, as already discussed. However, people have forgotten this and have turned completely to the lower life with all their abilities. Our master Mohammad (cpth) said:

“The Hour of utter ruin came so near, yet people continue to cling to this lower life and draw away from Al’lah.”

216

When they forget that of which they have been reminded, the Almighty opens up the treasures of the earth to them. However, in such cases, He then inevitably and suddenly destroys them, for the truth has become ambiguous to them due to their disbelief.

Thus,

“The prime example of this lower life is the rain which We drop from the sky. It mingles with the crops of the earth which sustain humankind and cattle...”:

such is the current state of the world. This is an example proving the imminent arrival of the Hour of destruction.

“…and then, when the earth is completely adorned…”

with airplanes, cars, buildings, palaces, phones, and so forth, and everything has appeared at its best and the temporary life seems to be in its complete adornment,

“…and luxuriantly bedecked…”

with electric lights,

“…and its people think that they can master it…”:

that is, they suppose they can take control of nature, thereby utterly shunning the Possessor of the Kingdom,

“…down comes Our Scourge upon it…”

to destroy it,

“…by night or in broad daylight…”:

at night in the east and during the day in the west,

“The Scourge lays it to waste as if it had not blossomed the day before”,

as if it had never existed.

“…Thus, for people who think, We make plain Our Revelations…”:

without careful thinking, you will not profit from this, nor will you find goodness inside yourself.

“Al’lah invites you into the Home

(Abode)

of Peace…”:

the abode of safety and rest,

“…He guides anyone who wishes to be guided…”:

meaning everyone who seeks to be guided to Him,

“…to a straight path”:

the invitation is a general one.

217

In another verse God says:

“Say: ‘tell me! Should His Scourge fall upon you by night or by day, to what punishment would the guilty hasten?”:

Can you drive away the affliction that will beset you at this Hour? How have you prepared yourself for its arrival? Do you expect a positive result?! Will you believe at the time of offliction, like Pharaoh?! Of what avail will your return be at the moment of doom?! The Almighty sent you to this world so that you could render good deeds, yet when the affliction comes, there will be no actions left for you to take. The Almighty granted you great abilities, but you have wasted them. Thoroughly consider this universe and the great miracles it contains. What is the purpose of this precision and arrangement? All of these cautions and warnings are given for your sake, so you must think deeply on them.

218

The Emergence of Smoke

God says:

“Then wait for the day when the sky will bring forth plain smoke, when grievous torment shall overwhelm oblivious humankind: ‘Oh our Provider! Would You please remove the torture from us, and we shall truly believe?’ How could the message be

(effectual)

for them after an undoubted Envoy had already come to them and they turned away from him, saying he was: ‘tutored

(by others)

, a madman.’ We shall remove their torment for a while. Truly! You will revert

(and retreat)

. Then We will seize you with the strongest grasp. We shall indeed send vengeful chastisement

(to bring out all that is hidden inside their spirits)

.”

219

This noble verse shows that the smoke that envelops people causes painful torment. Therefore, it undoubtedly does not refer to smoke from bombs, poisonous gases, forest fires, or the fires that are caused by explosions that occur in a particular area during one of the numerous wars that take place. It does not refer to the gases which emanate from factories and cars all over the world. These are minor conditions of the Hour. The world’s leaders have held many meetings to find a solution to these problems and they have made many agreements in relation to this. However, some have signed up to these agreements, while others have not. Whenever they meet to solve this problem, the sessions conclude in disagreement. This minor problem has negative effects on people, animals, and plants. It also affects the atmosphere and the global temperature (as can be seen in environmental pollution and the earth’s retention of heat). This has developed to the extent that the ice in the two poles has begun to melt dangerously.

Due to these sudden climatic changes that have resulted from this smoke, people have contracted many allergies and diseases, especially pectoral, respiratory, and skin diseases. The emergence of smoke from bombs and explosives in the places that are subjected to continuous war and disturbance has made some people appeal to their Provider to remove this affliction. However, the verse in the Qur’an is not referring to these incidents. It refers specifically to the smoke of nuclear bombs and the atomic vapor and poisonous gases that come from the fires caused by nuclear explosions. These occur in the east and west alike. The verse also pertains to the smoke that rises from burning oil in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, and all of the oil wells across the world.

It is during the Third World War that this affliction will materialize, along with the atomic bombs. It will first afflict the east and then the west.

This terrible smoke will drive the people of the Middle East to prayer, invoking

“‘Oh our Provider! Would You please remove the torture from us, and we shall truly believe?’ “

Because of this prayer, after the emergence of this smoke, the scourge will be driven away for a short time. Since people in the Middle East are afraid of this atomic smoke, they have invoked God and have promised to believe in Him if He removes the torment from them.

Nevertheless, their pretence will not last long, for they will return to their actions of old. When this happens, those people

-

and others

-

will be destroyed, on the day when God strikes the heavy blow of the Hour.

God says:

“Then wait for the day when the sky will bring forth plain smoke, when grievous torment shall overwhelm oblivious humankind”:

‘smoke’ here is undoubtedly a reference to atomic dust, as well as the nuclear rockets which release missiles of fire and flame, thereby generating this atomic dust.

“…shall overwhelm oblivious humankind”:

completely and across the whole of the earth, as this dust will be issued from the nuclear bombs that are dropped by both the east and the west. Sheikh Muhyiddin Ibn 'Arabi was referring to this when he said:

“Their capitals shall be destroyed, and so it shall be with the oil of the Gulf.”

This was mentioned in his poem which began:

“If the Jews are united with the Christians and they fly with iron up to the constellations, and when Al-Aqsa Mosque falls into the hands of the Jews and ruling is by women…”

“…when grievous torment shall overwhelm oblivious humankind:”:

by this time, alarm and fright will have filled the hearts of all people. Since this war will take place between the east and the west, the less developed countries

-

that is, the countries of the third world

-

will not be affected by the nuclear radiation of this war, as they are not considered to be opponents of either the eastern or western states. Instead, both the east and the west are now fighting for control of these regions, which are rich in oil, gas, and raw materials, and even gold and diamonds. For this reason the superpowers will not target the poorer countries, but will concentrate on beating each other. According to the words of Al’lah’s Envoy (cpth), the war will be confined to

“…two great powers having one pretense, fighting one another”:

that is, it will take place between the east and the west.

As for the weaker developing nations, they will be inflicted with feebleness, alarm and terror, and will seek refuge in Al’lah, saying:

“‘Oh our Provider! Would you please remove the torture from us, and we shall truly believe?’ “

The Almighty says:

“How could the message be

(effectual)

for them…”:

they will not receive any benefit from these gravities, nor shall they return with true repentance, because:

“…after an undoubted Envoy had already come to them…”:

who clarified the knowledge of this world and of the afterlife to them, and prophesied the facts of the past and the future (communication with Al’lah and peace are through him).

“…and they turned away from him, saying he was: ‘tutored

(by others)

, a madman’...”

meaning that his companions were teaching him in the morning and in the evening. The word

“madman”

means that the truth was hidden from him, and he could not see the truth (according to their perspective). He was speaking from visions and revelations that they did not accept.

“We shall remove their torment for a while...”:

this refers to the time after the destruction of the east and the west (except for those upon whom our Provider bestows mercy, and those with the capability for belief).

“Truly! You will revert

(and retreat)

…”:

you will return to your original lifestyle of entertainment and the commission of sin. At that point

“…We will seize you with the strongest grasp. We shall indeed send vengeful chastisement.”:

vengeance is visited upon people at a level proportional to the quality of the one who chastises them.

In Arabic, ‘to chastise somebody’ means to punish them so as to draw out what is folded inside their spirit. If the one who is doing the chastening is of sublime quality, their vengeance will be a means to get rid of the corruption in the heart of the person being chastened.

For instance, a father and a faithful tutor will chastise a child; that is, they punish the child with a punishment that extracts the evil that is folded in the spirit. Contrary to this, when persons of mean traits and lowly spirits wreak vengeance on their opponents, they are driven only by their trespasses and transgressions, without any purpose except to deprive the one being chastened of all the graces they enjoy. They may either discharge them of their employment, divesting them of the benefits they gained through it, or they may dispossess them of their freedom by imprisoning them. Furthermore, if the one who is performing vengeful chastisement has a criminal character, they may steal the money of those who they wish to chasten, or may even kill them. If the avenger is exaggerated in their criminality, they will do their best to pick at the faith of their victim so as to turn them back to aberration.

Thus, the statement,

“…We shall indeed send vengeful chastisement”

relates to those wrongdoers at the end of this world. They went astray and caused a lot of other people to do the same, as they deviated from the path of righteousness. When they are destroyed, their bodies will cease to exist, and the angels will restore their souls to their Creator while their spirits

-

which are an undying essence

-

shall taste only death, for there is no nothingness. At that time they will see that Al’lah wills, indeed, vengeful chastisement for them. After their utter ruin, they will realize the generous bounty and extreme kindness and care with which they were overwhelmed since they were in their mother’s womb, where they spent nine whole months without a moment’s cessation of the Godly Mercy. They will see how it continually provided them with floods of love, tenderness and compassion, and how it granted them hearing, vision and taste, and how it perfectly created all their members and their senses which are absolutely essential to them. There is also, of course, the milk which was prepared for them in their mothers’ breasts, and then their teeth were allowed to grow without deficiency for their own sake. This Godly Mercy sustained them with all that they required at every stage. Furthermore, it subjected the universe to prepare their food and drink, without forgetting them for even the twinkling of an eye. Had the Godly Presence forgotten them for just a moment, their hearts and lungs would have ceased to work and they would surely have died. That never occurred; on the contrary, they were always overwhelmed by oceans of Godly Mercy and Providential Sympathy, which were dashing eagerly to fulfill their yearnings all the while.

The Godly Mercy has never withheld anything from them

-

nay, it brought them up with tenderness, care, mercy, and grace.

It invited them only to obey Al’lah for the endless Paradises they would attain through Him, but alas! They did not respond, and each of them shunned and disobeyed the One Who loves them, yielding to their enemy, Satan. They dispensed with their witnessing of the Merciful and Compassionate, Who wished only for them to enjoy the Paradises He had prepared for them. This is the truth which they will perceive after their death. The yearnings which veil them from their Provider’s Light will leave them, and by then they will have remembered the merciful Godly Treatments. They will also remember how they met them with hardheartedness, meanness, wickedness, shunning of the right path, and evil hurtful deeds. When they experience this state of remembrance, they will set to bemoaning their loss, but it will be too late, and their regret will avail them nothing. They will have suffered a gross failure for which they can never be compensated, as the time for work will have passed them by.

Accordingly, when we say that someone has had revenge against someone else, the meaning is that they have shown them the feeling that was folded in their spirit.

Thus, the vengeance of the Almighty is carried out when He shows His creatures His loving and merciful Dealings and the wickedness with which they responded, and how they fought against Him and against His people, who were like entrances through which they could have reached Paradise. At that time, remorse, regret, weeping and sighing shall consume them and inflame the fires of the humility and loss that are in their hearts, causing them to suffer the burning of an unbearable hellish fire inside themselves. This fire will be of intense heat, and will not be extinguished except through the burning of the Fire of Al’lah.

In brief, we say: the statement

“…We shall indeed send vengeful chastisement”

means that We will show them and allow them to witness all that We have driven to them, and all that they have brought upon themselves.

All of the indications of the Hour have occurred except for the atomic strike, and this will happen shortly and will be between east and west. This is what will result in the terrible smoke that comes from atomic bombs.

The Minor Indications of the Hour

Besides these conditions, others are mentioned in the Prophetic Tradition, such as when the Envoy (cpth) says:

“The Hour will not happen unless God’s Book becomes shameful...”.

That means that people will reproach the believers who follow the Book. This is especially the case when the issue is related to social relations in any form.

“...and the religion of Islam becomes strange; rancor appears among people; divine science disappears…”:

the word ‘science’ here refers to knowledge of the Supreme Attributes of Al’lah.

“…the disloyal person becomes trustworthy while the loyal one is charged with disloyalty; the liar is believed while the honest person is accused of lying; rooms are built above each other until they become high; injustice, envy and miserliness spread; fancy is followed, while judgment becomes dependent on supposition; divine science becomes rare while ignorance pervades; the sun causes discomfort and winter becomes like midsummer; preachers tell lies and claim that the Envoy will intercede to save the evildoers of his nation from their punishment

(fire)

on Doomsday; and truth disappears.”

220

He (cpth) also says:

“People will arrive at a time when no one follows the divine scholar, no one feels shame before one who forbears, and no one respects the old or has mercy on the young. They will kill each other for the sake of the worldly life. Their hearts will be like those of foreigners, although their tongues speak Arabic. §§§§§

Before telling the story of our master Jesus (pth), we have to present the following words. We say: God has created each human to be composed of three elements: a body, a spirit and a soul.

The body

This is the material bulk consisting of flesh, bones, blood vessels, nerves, and blood. It is possible for our bodies to have many opposing characteristics, such as strength and weakness, good-health and sickness, thinness and corpulence, or youthfulness and senility.

The spirit

This is the immaterial conscious self of humanity. It is a Godly Light and its centre is the chest. Its rays spread to all the different parts of the body through the nerves. This spirit, confined in the body, is aware of the things that surround it through the senses. It sees with the eye, hears with the ear, smells with the nose, feels and touches with the skin and tastes flavours of things with the tongue, which is also used to express ideas and thoughts.

In detail, we say that if one stands at the sea shore, watching the sea will undoubtedly make this person revere and glorify the scene before them. This submission and glorification is of the spirit.

If we see someone dear to us whose hand is bleeding because it is badly wounded, we feel sorry for them and sympathise with them. This pain and grief are of the spirit.

If we hear that one of our dear relatives has returned safely from a long journey, we feel pleased and happy. This pleasure and happiness are of the spirit.

Thus, the spirit is the essential element of the human person. It glorifies and submits, grieves and becomes annoyed, delights and rejoices, feels contented and angry, and tastes, enjoys and suffers. It is the centre of existence.

The ‘spirit’ is always addressed in the Qur’an. It is charged to follow the straight path. It feels pain when it is treated in order to be cured. It enjoys being in Paradise, and does not like to be removed therefrom. It is called a ‘spirit’, which is derived from a word in Arabic meaning ‘magnificent value’.

The soul

The soul is the support of the Godly Light which flows into the blood. Its centre is the physical heart, and it is the power that moves all of the systems and cells of the body. Through it the body nourishes itself and moves, so the life of the body depends on the soul. It is the executive power of the aims, requirements and demands of the spirit, and of all that the spirit desires.

The soul is under the command of the spirit, which moves through its rays within the nerves of the body. The spirit directs and controls all of the voluntary and involuntary organs. The souls of human beings, animals and all living creatures are the same, but in the case of the Prophets and Envoys, it is a sacred soul. This sacred soul is far removed from impurities and low purposes, because the spirits of these people are not contaminated by the stains and dirt of this worldly life. Their souls remain virtuous, pure and sacred, so that they only utter what is good, right, virtuous and perfect. Wherever they settle, goodness, bliss, blessings, happiness and the delightful eternal Beatitude of Al’lah spread over all those who direct themselves towards them, and all those who are around them.

The Prophet Mohammad (cpth) was asked about the soul. He explained the soul and its rays that flow through the body by means of the blood. The prophetic saying reads:

“Satan flows through a son of Adam as the blood circulates in the body.”

If God had withdrawn His Support

It flows into the blood by means of its rays, and the blood then carries nourishment and oxygen throughout the body, and carries the wastes and toxins that are to be rejected from the body through urination and exhaling.

that is, He made Zechariah (pth) responsible for rearing her. The Almighty entrusts anyone who is honest with Him to the care of a person who is likewise honest with Him.

When this girl-child grew up and began to understand and observe things, her heart became filled with love for God and a love for entering into His Presence. This was because she was continually thinking of God’s Boons, the making of His universal graces, and the food and drink that He bestows upon everybody. In her reflection and in that line of thinking, she was similar to our father Abraham (pth). He thought of the universal signs of God and attained a knowledge of God, just as our master Mohammad (cpth) did later on. Because of her entry into His Presence, God overwhelmed her heart with science and knowledge, just as He did the hearts of His near believing obedient followers (ibad).

Whenever our Master Zechariah (pth) entered her Mihrab

-

where she was alone, obeying God and repelling the devil

-

he found a spiritual sustenance within her: that is, science, knowledge and revelation about God’s Perfection. He admired that and asked her: “where did you get this science and this high knowledge from, Mary?”

She said: “it is from God.”

The Almighty revealed that in His noble Saying:

“…Whenever Zechariah entered her shrine, he found a

(spiritual)

sustenance accompanying her. ‘Mary!’ he said, ‘Where did you get this from?’ ‘It is from God,’ she answered, ‘Al’lah grants to those who want, for nothing

(except true determination for truth)

’.”

In saying

“…Al’lah grants to those who want…”,

she meant that He grants His Favor to every true person. She was true with her Provider in seeking the truth, so she contemplated His Favor and believed, and He obliged her as He did

“...for nothing.”:

that is, to receive this sustenance she needed no more than truthfulness.

As he was childless, when Zechariah (pth) saw that and heard what he heard from her, he called on God to grant him a pious son to take his place and become a guide after him. He prayed to his Provider, saying what is mentioned in the noble verse, wherein God says:

“Thereupon Zechariah prayed to his Provider, saying: ‘oh my Provider! Grant me upright offspring out of Your Favor. You hear the prayer’.”

255

Thus, the context of the verse shows us that the sustenance which our Master Zechariah (pth) found within this girl in the shrine was not nut or pomegranate or any other fruit. Such things are not what the Prophets demand; nor do they make the Prophets yearn for children or pray to God to have a child.

This wicked claim casts doubt upon her honour (far be it from her). Undoubtedly, the provision was the science and knowledge which he (pth) found that she had and which he heard from her. That is what made him appreciate and esteem her, because it is only the possessors of favor who can appreciate it.

Our lady Mary (peace is upon her) continued to direct herself towards her Provider without stopping. This continuous link with her Provider continuously purified her spirit, until this purity raised her to a level where she deserved to be chosen by her Provider to be set above all the other women of the world. For this reason, her position became the highest of all women, and she was the greatest in rank before God among all women.

This spiritual clarity increased until it reached a degree where the gentle light of the spirit overcame the thick veil of the body, which allows a person to witness the noble angels, to address them, and to be addressed by them. The noble verses refer to that spiritual purity and the selection of Mary, indicating the spiritual sublimation which qualified this noble lady to be addressed by the noble angels and to hear their words. In His Holy Book, the Almighty says:

“The angels said: ‘oh Mary! Al’lah has selected you. He has made you pure and chosen you above all the women of the world. Mary, keep directing yourself towards your Provider; prostrate yourself and bow with the bowing men’.”

256

In its reality, this bowing is spiritual submission to God. It is the submission which emerges in the spirit of a believer who has witnessed the Perfection and Tenderness of their Provider, and who has appreciated Him with the level of appreciation He deserves, having known His Compassion for and Charity towards His creation. Accordingly, the bowing people are the noble Prophets and Envoys. Due to the high and lofty rank of this true woman, the Almighty ordered her to continue directing herself towards Him, and to prostrate herself and bow with the bowing people who keep glorifying the Prestige of their Provider. Those men are none other than the Prophets, such as our masters Zechariah and Jesus (ptt).

Your Provider then wanted to bestow grace upon her as He had bestowed grace upon her mother before her, so He made her the mother of one of His noble Envoys: our master Jesus Christ (pth). The coming of that Envoy to this world occurred through a miracle of God, and after his birth he displayed another such miracle. Many observable miracles were performed later at his hands. The Almighty revealed those signs so that they would be a lesson to those who consider and reflect, so that these miracles could draw the attention of the ungrateful, and stimulate their thought

-

hitherto inactive

-

thus returning them to the right path and to knowledge of their Creator.

Now, let us begin with the miracle by which this noble Envoy came into this life. It is the miracle of how his mother became pregnant with him, although there was no father. We say:

At the beginning of our discussion of the story of this noble Envoy, we introduced the fact that the Almighty God put a system and a rule into place for humanity’s exodus to this life. As for our master Jesus (pth), his birth and coming to this world was an exception to this rule. His spirit was not carried by a father but, as previously mentioned, an angel carried that noble spirit to the lady Mary (peace is upon her). At that time, she was in her place of worship, separated from her family, devoted to directing herself towards her Provider and fully entering into His Presence. Suddenly, she saw Gabriel (peace is upon him) before her. The Almighty God had sent him to her in the semblance of a human being. Indicating the story of this pregnancy, God says:

“Recount in the Book, Mary: how she retired away from her people to a blessed place and put a veil between her and them. We sent Our Soul to her in the semblance of a man

(of flesh and blood)

.”

257

Our lady Mary became confused when she saw this person in front of her when she was alone, and thought him to be a man. Therefore

“She said: ‘I seek refuge in the Compassionate from you’

…”: that is, “I have resorted to and have sought protection and might in the Compassionate from you; who are you?”

The significance of the verse is that he informed her that he was one of God’s angels. However, she answered him:

“…‘

(even)

if you were a pious one’.”:

that is,

“even if you are an angel, what do you want? Have you the right to disobey God’s Orders, which forbid you to be alone with a woman you do not know? If not, what is your purpose?”

He answered her as it is outlined in the noble verse:

“…‘I am the Messenger of your Provider and have come to give you a pure holy son’.”:

that is: “I have been sent by Al’lah, the Almighty. I do not have any desires because I am not charged with bearing the Trust. I am an angel. I have committed myself to God since Al-Azal world, so I have no worldly desires at all. I am an angel that was sent to give you a virtuous and pure boy that shall be of high title and position.”

She found that it was strange that she would have a son when she was unmarried and had not been touched by any man, so she said to him:

“…‘how shall I have a child when no man has touched me and I would never be a harlot?’ He said: ‘In a case such as yours, your Provider said: “It is easy for Me. We should make him a sign to mankind and a mercy from Us. It is a decided matter.”’

“

The angel placed the spirit of our master Jesus into our lady Mary through her mouth while she was talking to him (peace is upon her). The pure spirit of our master Jesus flowed into her as the light flows, or as wireless power flows along the ether into the phone; he (pth) was carried in her womb. God indicated that in His noble Saying:

“Thereupon she conceived him and retired with him to a far-off place. The throes of childbirth drew her to the trunk of the palm tree”:

that is, the pain of childbirth made her shelter and remain by the trunk of a palm tree. Besides the pain of childbirth, she suffered a spiritual pain that was greater than her physical pain. It arose from her fear that people might accuse her of adultery. She was worried that there would be a lot of gossip about her, since nobody knew anything about the miracle of her pregnancy. If she tried to tell them the truth of what had happened, they might not believe her and might blame her and harshly accuse her of sin.

She passed through great grief and sadness, as it is hard for the honest to be falsely accused. They would prefer to die rather than have their reputation or their honor tarnished. Therefore

“She said: ‘oh, would that I had died before this, and passed into oblivion!’ “

Our lady Mary gave birth to our master Jesus (pth) in a trice. God wanted to alleviate her suffering and sadness, and so let her newborn speak at the moment of his birth. The noble verse refers to this when God says:

“He called her from below: ‘do not be sad, your Provider has created a notable son beneath you’.”:

that is, the fame and high prestige of this son would spread all over the world. Then, this newborn continued to speak, saying:

“Shake the trunk of the palm-tree and it will drop fresh fruit over you. Eat, drink and rejoice, and should you meet any mortal say: ‘I have vowed a fast to the Compassionate and will not speak with any man today’.”

258

The word

“…fast…”

here means a cessation of speech.

Our lady Mary appeared with her baby. Indicating that, God says:

“She came to her people carrying him. They said: ‘Mary! You have done an abominable thing! Sister of Aaron, your father was never an evil-doer, nor your mother a harlot’.”

The statement

“Sister of Aaron…”

means that she was his sister in piety and goodness, and that she was like him in purity.

“She pointed to him. They said: ‘How can we speak with a babe in the cradle?’ “

Nevertheless, our master Jesus (pth) spoke despite the fact that he was in the cradle. The Almighty God wanted to make him talk as a miracle, on one hand revealing that his mother was innocent of any charge which she may have been accused of, and on the other hand drawing attention to the miracle of his conception without a father. Through this they might appreciate this birth, and might believe in God’s Might as well as in the message of this newborn when he was charged with God’s Mission.

The noble verses refer to the utterance of our master Jesus (pth) in the cradle; God says:

“He said: ‘I am the strict obedient follower of Al’lah. He has granted me the Book and ordained me a Prophet. He blessed me wherever I may go and advised me to perform communication

(prayer)

and achieve purification

(Zakat)

for as long as I shall live. He made me charitable to my mother, and did not make me arrogant or distressed. Peace is upon me on the day when I was born, on the day when I shall die, and on the day when I shall be raised to vivid life.’ That is Jesus, the son of Mary. That is the right saying, of which they are unenlightened. Al’lah never begot a son. Glory to Him! When He judges a thing, He just says to it ‘Be’ and it will be. Al’lah is my Provider and your Provider, therefore obey Him. This is a straight path.”

259

He tells us the story of our lady Mary’s pregnancy with our master Jesus (pth), and reveals the miracle of his speech (pth) when he was still in the cradle, proving the innocence of the lady Mary. This also illustrates the message of our master Jesus (pth) and demonstrates his capacity as an obedient follower of Al’lah and one of His noble Envoys. Then the Almighty concludes with His noble saying:

“That is Jesus, the son of Mary. That is the right saying, of which they are unenlightened. Al’lah never begot a son. Glory to Him! When He judges a thing, He just says to it ‘Be’ and it will be.”

260

The words

“…Glory to Him…”

that are mentioned in this verse show that God is far above having a son. That is because one of the son’s defining characteristics is that he has his father’s properties and is similar to him. However, the Almighty is far above being similar to anyone in His Identity or in any of His Supreme Attributes.

In more detail, we say: the Almighty Al’lah is First, without having had any beginning. There was no beginning to His existence. Whatever you say first, He is first and first. He had no beginning, whilst our master Jesus, the son of Mary, has a beginning, which was the moment that he came into the world of existence. Thus, in this respect, he is like everything else in the rest of creation, which has a beginning and an end. The beginning of being is something that relates to creation but is in conflict with Godhood.

The Almighty Al’lah is Self-Supporting in His Identity and in every one of His Attributes. The Self-Supporting one is one who provides and never is provided for, and He is in no need of anyone. For example, the Almighty Al’lah is Self-Supporting in His life; that is, nobody provides Him with life. His life is not dependant on anyone or anything. He is the Living and the Source and Origin of life; the life of every creature is taken from Him alone.

As for our master Jesus (pth), he is, in this respect, like the rest of creation. His life (pth) is provided by Al’lah. If God’s Sustenance, necessary for life, ceases to be provided to our master Jesus, he will immediately die. Also, God is Self-made; that is, He needs neither agent nor anything else to continue existing. However, our master Jesus is subordinate to the cosmic rules which the Almighty created for all living creatures. He needs food, drink, light, and air, and the continuity of his existence depends on many conditions, just as is the case with the rest of creation.

Moreover, the son is begotten to help his father. The Almighty, on the other hand, needs no help from any of His creatures, but on the contrary, He supplies them with everything. Would it then be acceptable for the Mighty Creator to seek the help of a weak creature who had no power or might of their own?

Over and above all else, God surrounds all the existing creatures. He is greater than everything and bigger than everything. As for our master Jesus (pth), he was carried on the earth and surrounded by air, space and the heavens. All of these are contrary to the qualities of Godhood. Although there are those who ascribe Godhead to this noble Envoy, this claim is invalidated by the noble verses; God says:

“Those who said that Al’lah is the Messiah, the son of Mary are unbelievers, for the Messiah himself said: ‘Children of Israel, obey Al’lah, my Provider and your Provider.’ He that obeys other gods besides Al’lah shall be forbidden Paradise, and the Fire shall be his resort. None shall help the wrongdoers. Those who say that Al’lah is one of three are unbelievers. There is no god except the one God. If they do not desist from saying this, those of them that disbelieve shall be sternly punished. Will they not turn to Al’lah in repentance and seek forgiveness from Him? Al’lah is Forgiving and Merciful. The Messiah, the son of Mary, was no more than an Envoy, just like other Envoys who passed away before him. His mother was a true woman. They both ate food. See how We make plain to them the proof; then see where they direct themselves. Say: will you worship, instead of Al’lah, that which can neither harm nor help you? Al’lah hears all and knows all.”

261

The fact that life depends on the consumption of food and drink is in contradiction with the qualities of the Godhead. If God’s Envoy, Jesus (pth), remains without food for a few days, he will weaken and lose his strength, whereas it is impossible for God to weaken; otherwise, the universe would collapse. As we saw, God is Self-Supporting; that is, His life depends on nothing and He does not need anything: He is Self-Sufficient and everything is in need of Him.

The Almighty God sent our master Jesus (pth) to the Israelites when the people of his time had great skill and knowledge in medicine. Therefore He supported him with clear miracles suitable for the age of Jesus, which could not have been achieved by any contemporary people, whatever their skill in medicine and therapy. In this way, He substantiated his mission, in order that people would glorify and follow their Envoy. Then their spirit would accompany that pure and virtuous spirit, and rise with it to their Creator, where they would witness the Godly Perfection and see reality by that Godly Light. Then they would be able to discriminate between vice and virtue and between truth and untruth, and could turn from the worldly life and its vanities to approach Al’lah, the Almighty, by doing good actions and seeking the hereafter.

Among the miracles with which the Almighty supported this noble Envoy were curing the deaf and the lepers, and raising the dead to life by God’s Leave. The Almighty refers to the miracles He brought into being at the hands of this Envoy, saying:

“He will send him forth as an Envoy to the Israelites to say: ‘I bring you a sign from your Provider. I will make for you the likeness of a bird from clay. I shall breathe into it and by Al’lah’s Leave, it shall become a living bird. By Al’lah’s Leave I shall heal the deaf and the leper, and raise the dead to life. I shall tell you what to eat and what to store up in your houses. Surely that will be a sign for you, if you are true believers’.”

262

And God says:

“Al’lah will say: ‘Jesus, son of Mary, remember the favor I have bestowed on you and on your mother; how I supported you with the Holy Soul, so that you spoke to people in the cradle and then in middle age; how I taught you the Book, the Wisdom, the Torah and the Gospel; how by My Leave you fashioned from clay the likeness of a bird and breathed into it so that, by My Leave, it became a living bird; how by My Leave, you healed the deaf man and the leper, and by My Leave restored the dead to life; how I protected you from the Israelites when you brought them veritable signs, and the unbelievers among them said: “this is nothing but plain magic.”’

“

263

The Almighty God supported His Envoy with the distinct miracle of raising the dead to life because, no matter how the science of medicine may develop, no physician in any time and place is able to raise the dead to life. However, people do not benefit from whatever signs they see or whatever miracles they witness unless they themselves think of the marvels of this universe, and recognize their Creator through them. They will never turn from their error or appreciate the miracles that God reveals at the hands of His Envoys as long as they keep on in their unbelief; that is to say, as long as they have no appreciation or exaltation of God’s cosmic miracles.

This is the Messiah master, our master Jesus Christ, the son of Mary (pth), who fashioned the likeness of a bird from clay, and then, by God’s Leave, breathed into it so that it became a living bird. He healed the blind and the leper and restored the dead to life by God’s Leave. However, in spite of all that, you find unbelievers. That is to say, there were those who did not appreciate God’s Signs and Graces or pay attention to them, but instead accused Jesus of using magic, just as they did with the other Envoys (ptt), saying: “this is nothing but plain magic.” Moreover, they defamed Mary and fabricated stories against her, despite hearing the speech of our master Jesus (pth) in the cradle.

Side by side with those shunning unbelievers, you can find others that did not really believe in God; nor did they recognize their Creator through contemplation and inference. All that they did was imitate their forefathers in blind imitation. When they saw what miracles they saw at the hands of our master Jesus (pth), they became exaggerated in their religion and also became unbelievers.

A group of them said that Al’lah was the Messiah, the son of Mary. Another group said that the Messiah was the son of Al’lah. There are others who said that Al’lah was one of three, claiming that our master Jesus and his mother were gods besides Al’lah, as mentioned in previous verses. However, the Almighty God condemned their lies and their unbelief when He acquainted us with the attitude of our master Jesus (pth) before His Hands on Doomsday, and referred to the lies that they falsely claimed were on the tongue of His noble Envoy. God says:

“Then Al’lah will say: Jesus, son of Mary, did you ever say to mankind ‘worship me and my mother as gods besides Al’lah?’ ‘Glory to you’ he will answer: ‘How could I say that which I have no right to say? If I had ever said so, You would surely have known it. You know what is in me, but I cannot know what is in You. You alone know what is hidden. I spoke to them of nothing except what You bade me, that is “Worship Al’lah, my Provider and yours”.

I watched over them whilst living in their midst, and ever since You made me sleep, You Yourself were the Watcher over them. You are the Witness of all things’.”

264

The Israelites displayed great opposition to our master Jesus (pth), just as they had before with other noble Envoys who were sent to them. They were infatuated with the worldly life and its delights, due to their shunning of their Provider. Therefore, whenever an Envoy brought something that their spirits did not desire, they refused to accept it. Indicating this attitude of theirs towards His Envoys, God says:

“…is it acceptable for you to disdain whatever an Envoy brings you that your spirits do not desire, charging some with imposture and opposing others?”

265

The Israelites planned a weighty plot against our master Jesus. In reference to that plot, God says:

“When Jesus observed that they had no faith, he said: ‘Who will be my helpers in the cause of Al’lah?’ The disciples replied: ‘We are the helpers of Al’lah. We believe in God. Bear witness that we have surrendered to Him. Our Provider! We believe in what You sent and we have followed the Envoy. Count us among the witnesses’.”

Unbelief drove those enemies who did not believe in their Provider to plot to kill His Envoy (pth). God says:

“They plotted, and Al’lah plotted. Al’lah is the supreme plotter

(for goodness)

.”

266

Our master Jesus (pth) felt distressed because of those unbelievers. That is because the spirit of the believer is like a pure mirror; the states of enemies are reflected on it, making the believer feel distressed with them, thus suffering great gloom while in their presence. The Almighty God therefore promised His Envoy (pth) that He would purify him of the unbelievers, and bid him rejoice. God says:

“Al’lah said: Jesus, I am about to take you back and lift you up to Me. I shall purify you of the unbelievers and exalt your followers above those who disbelieve till the Day of Resurrection. Then, to Me you shall all return and I shall judge your disputes.”

267

The First Proof of the Return of Jesus Christ (pth)

Al’lah the Almighty says:

“Al’lah said: ‘Jesus, I am about to take you back and lift you up to Me. I shall purify you of the unbelievers and exalt your followers above those who disbelieve till the Day of Resurrection. Then, to Me you shall all return and I shall judge your disputes’.”

268

The Meaning of ‘Taking Back’

In the noble verse

“…I am about to take you back…”,

the statement

“…take you back…”

does not indicate only death, because ‘taking back the spirit’ also happens during sleep. God says:

“It is He Who takes you back by night knowing what you have done by day, and then rouses you up to fulfill your allotted span…”

269

When you say: “I have taken back something”, it means that you had given others the right to act as they wished with one of your possessions for a certain time, until it is returned to you in full. Accordingly, and to show what is intended by ‘taking back the spirit’, we say that the Almighty God has granted the human spirit the freedom of choice in the world; according to your choices, God fulfills your aims and desires. People choose and make demands, and then God supplies them with sustenance, power, might and movement; taking back this freedom of choice is what is meant by taking back the spirit.

Spirits are taken back during sleep just as they are taken back when death occurs.

In the state of sleep, the spirit is taken back when God takes back its freedom of choice for a short while. Therefore, when people surrender to sleep, they do not wake up until God gives freedom of choice back to their spirits and returns His Gift to them.

Regarding the state of death, at this time the spirit is taken back when its freedom of choice is returned to God forever. Referring to this taking back of the spirit in death and during sleep, and illustraing the difference between the two cases, God says:

“It is Al’lah who takes back the spirit at the time of death, and from those who have not died during their sleep. He takes back those on whom He has passed the decree of death, but He sends the rest for an appointed term…”

270

Taking back the spirit at the time of death also differs from taking it back during sleep, in whether or not each state is accompanied by the taking back of the soul and its removal from the body.

Since the soul is the Godly Light, by means of which the body lives and through which its systems work regularly, thus when it is taken back from the body, the body becomes motionless and all its systems cease fulfilling their functions. Consequently, the body becomes lifeless and begins to perish, and its existence starts to come to an end. However, the soul is taken back by an angel. The angel who is charged with breathing the soul into a person’s body when they become an embryo

-

that is, when the semen that has been created moves into the mother’s womb

-

is also charged with taking the soul back from the body at the time of death. God says:

“Say Mohammad: ‘the angel of death who has been put in charge of you will take you back…’.”

271

And He says:

“…when death comes to one of you, Our angels will take him back. They do not neglect their duty.”

272

According to what we have mentioned, if the words ‘taking back’ are joined with the word ‘angel’, they then refer to taking back the soul; that is to say, death, and the end of life.

Having revealed the meaning of ‘taking back’ and the difference between taking back the spirit at the time of death and during sleep, we say:

Since the statement

“…I am about to take you back…”

with which the Almighty God addressed our master Jesus (pth) was not joined to a mention of an angel, it does not refer to taking back the soul

-

that is, death. It is absolutely certain that it refers to taking back the spirit only; that is, the return of freedom of choice to God which occurs during sleep.

Thus, the Almighty God had taken back our master Jesus’ spirit, leaving him asleep, and had hidden his body out of sight. The same thing had happened to the sleepers of the cave. God let them sleep for hundreds of years without their bodies perishing, and then roused them from sleep. His purpose was to give a moral lesson to the people of the age in which He roused them.

God says:

“We made them sleep in the cave for many years, and then We awakened them to know which group could best tell the length of their stay!”

273

Our master Jesus (pth) knew that nothing brings the obedient follower nearer to their Creator than their high deeds, and nothing raises them up to that noble Godly Presence except doing good things and calling people to the way of righteousness and belief. However, since our master Jesus was met with disbelief and opposition by his people, and since only a few of them responded to his guidance, he felt sorrow when God told him that He would take him back, because his sublime intention had not been fulfilled and his aims had not been achieved during that era.

The Almighty wanted to console Jesus in the face of people’s indifference, and to let him know the benefit he would accrue from God. Therefore He says:

“…and I shall lift you up to Me…”,

that is: do not be sad. I will certainly send you to the people once more, to call them to believe, and, indeed, they will do so. I shall lift you up to Me through the humanist deeds you will render from your truthfulness and high intention, and through your acts in the future calling My creatures to Me, and making every effort to help them follow the way of belief.

Therefore, the statement:

“…and I shall lift you up to Me…”

does not mean that he (pth) was physically lifted up into the sky, as is understood by some people. The verse shows clearly that God said:

“…and I shall lift you up to Me…”

and did not say:

“and I shall lift you up to the sky.”

The Almighty God is the Great Creator who has no end. He is far above being in any particular time or place, since He is the Maker of time and place. Besides, the sky and the earth are in the same rank and position in relation to God. Each of them is a creation, so raising a person up to the sky does not uplift their rank. The only things which elevate a person to their Creator and make them approach His Noble Presence are high deeds, strife in the cause of God, and calling people to follow the right path and guiding them to the way of belief.

The ‘raising’ indicated by the noble verse refers to a rise in rank and prestige rather than a raising up of the body. For example, if we were to say

“the prince has lifted up a guide to him”,

it would mean that he had made the guide closer to him in rank and position, not in body or place.

God says:

“…and the good deed raises

(exalts)

him…”

274

He also says:

“And tell in the Book of Idris: he was a saintly Prophet whom We raised

(exalted)

to high rank.”

275

And says:

“…Al’lah will raise to high rank those among you who have faith and knowledge…”

276

I say: something which also refutes the claim that our master Jesus (pth) was raised up to the sky is God’s Saying:

“We made the son of Mary and his mother a miracle and gave them a shelter on a hillside of firm mountain and spring.”

277

It was reported that the Prophet (cpth) asked those who were around him about this verse:

“…and gave them a shelter on a hillside of firm mountain and spring”

saying:

“…‘do you know where it is?’ to which they replied: ‘Al’lah and His Envoy know best.’ He said: ‘it is in Al-Sham, on a land called Al-Guta, by a city called Damascus. It is the best city of Muslims’.”

278

In his book,

The Travels of Ibn Jubayr

, the historian Ibn Jubayr as well as Al-Baidawi who explained the Holy Qur’an mentioned that this shelter was to be found on a hill of Damascus. In some traditions, it is said that the appearance of our master Jesus (pth) in the last age will take place in Damascus.

Having revealed what is meant by the words ‘taking back’ and ‘lifting up’ mentioned in the noble verse, we say:

After the Almighty God promised our master Jesus (pth) that He would bring him back to call people to follow the straight path, He wanted to set his heart at ease. He told him that the people of the time during which he would return again would be guided by him, and that as a result, the whole world would believe in God. So it is that the country of disbelief will disappear and be replaced by the country of monotheism and belief. At that time, people everywhere will adopt the right path; so, you will not be aggrieved by anyone; nor will you feel the distress you suffer at this time because of your meetings with people of unbelief and error. You will realize purity and pleasure, and will feel absolute disengagement from all unbelievers. That is what the noble verse refers to when God says:

“…I shall purify you from the unbelievers.”

God then clarified that this nation

-

the nation of faith

-

will remain in existence until Doomsday. Throughout that period, believers will continue to have prestige and authority, and all people will follow their guidance.

God says:

On the contrary, verses have been revealed that clarify that our master Jesus is asleep, and that he and his mother are currently on a peaceful hill-side watered by a fresh spring. Besides this, other verses can be found that refute the pretense that he is a god. For example, there are the following words of the Almighty:

“The Messiah, son of Mary, is no more than an Envoy: other Envoys passed away before him. His mother is a saintly woman. They both were eating earthly food…”:

if he needs food is it possible for him to be a god? Could a god be needy and powerless? How, then, could he feed and sustain others?

“…see how We make plain to them Our Revelations…”:

is this not proof enough against them?

“…then see how they ignore the truth”:

see how they shun the truth. He who does not eat for days becomes powerless; can he then support all of creation?

306

Had the Messiah master (pth) died, God would have added this fact to the previous verse to act as evidence against those who worship the Messiah master, but He

-

the Almighty

-

did not say that. He (glory to Him) has proved the mortality of the Messiah master and his mother (ptt) through referring to their need of food and drink, and He did not touch on the subject of his death at this point.

§§§§§

Now it is our duty to reveal the truth and the real causes behind the case of our master Adam’s descent. This is necessary because the descent of our master Adam (pth) from lofty Paradise to the abode of deeds and toil is an object of dispute among the people of heavenly Books, who put our father Adam (pth) in the wrong, accusing him of disobedience and ingratitude. Furthermore, our brothers the Christians believe that the reason for the coming of our master Jesus (pth) is that he may expiate their sins and sacrifice his blood for the original sin of our master Adam (pth). Far be it from him; therefore we must reveal the reality of this issue.

The First Teacher; Our Master Adam (pth), the Father and Teacher of all Humanity

Al’lah says:

“Then, your Provider said to the angels: I will make a successor of Mine on earth…”

307

In the Holy Qur’an, the Almighty God has outlined the stories of a group of the Prophets, which reveal the purity of their faithful spirits and their impeccability and freedom from any sin due to their continuous entering into the Presence of their Provider. The people of belief are aware of these stories and have seen the sublimity of the people indicated therein, and have heard about the great deeds they rendered, and the noble manners and high qualities by which they were distinguished. Indeed, nobody knows people of belief except people of belief, nobody appreciates favor except those who bestow favor, and nobody realizes the great lessons and examples in the Holy Qur’an except those who are close to Al’lah and have worn the garment of perfection.

God says:

“In their stories, there is a lesson to men of true faith…”

308

He also says:

“Those examples We give to oblivious people, but none will get them into their mind except those who study Al’lah’s Attributes.”

309

The following is what the Almighty has revealed about our master Adam (pth). He says:

“Then, your Provider said to the angels: ‘I will make a successor of Mine on earth.’ They said: ‘Will You place on it those who will corrupt and shed blood and we glorify with Your Praise and purify for You?’ He said: ‘I

(scientifically)

know what you do not know’.”

310

The Angels

When God offered to give the spirits the freedom of choice in the world of Al-Azal, there was one type of being that refused to enter this field (which was entered by humanity at that time). This group accepted that they would have no freedom of choice, and gave the possession of their will to God. Therefore they were called ‘angels.’ In Arabic, the word ‘angels’ means ‘the ones who surrendered themselves to God.’ Because they lack bodies like those of humans, they are devoid of the material desires to which humanity inclines and are without physical requirements. They do not eat or drink; they do not get married or reproduce or enjoy any such things.

When your Provider said to the angels

“…I will make a successor of Mine on earth…”,

they wished to have the honor of holding that rank, because the successor of God is that high being who is qualified to be God’s viceroy, informing His creatures of His Orders, acquainting them with Him and

-

by keeping company with them

-

entering them into His Presence. Due to the clemency, mercy, science, wisdom, justice, love for creation and sublimity of manners that Adam (pth) derived from his Creator, he became worthy of being God’s successor on His land, establishing justice and truth among people, and spreading goodness and uprightness on the earth.

The noble verse indicates this; God says, addressing our master David (pth):

“David, We have made you a successor in the land. Rule with justice among people…”

311

This successor holds a position of giving signs and guidance in addition to their position of rule.

In Al-An’am Fortress, God says:

“Those men upon whom We bestowed the Book, wisdom, and Prophethood…”

312

Because of the knowledge of his Provider and His Supreme Attributes that he (pth) attained, and due to the love and infatuation for his Creator that was impressed on his heart, Adam deserved to become a mediator between Al’lah and every being in creation. He informed them of His Orders, acquainted them with His Perfection and Supreme Attributes, and showed them the way that leads to knowledge of Him.

If they bound themselves up with him and drew near to God in his company, he would enter their spirits into God’s Presence and be a shining lamp for them. By the light of this lamp they would be able to see an aspect of the Godly Names and witness the Godly Perfection, becoming infatuated with it. He would enable them to obtain a brand of the Godly Light by which they could see goodness and know that it is really good, and see evil and know that it is really evil.

In this way, the successor’s relationship to creation will be similar to that of a sympathetic father to his children, or a rational brother to his brothers and parents. He will be the one who is most pitying of and affectionate to them, most tender-hearted and merciful with them, and most helpful to them. For this reason, he will be the most beloved creature to God, the most honored, the most high-ranked and the nearest one to Him. That is the degree of success for which humanity was made fit by God the Almighty; this is the level which the noble angels wished to attain.

The creation of jinn-kind took place before the creation of humankind. The noble verse refers to this; God says:

“We created man from dry clay that was purified and sharpened by being heated by God’s holy light, and before him the jinn, from pure flame.”

313

However, since the devil and his offspring had corrupted the land because of their shunning of Al’lah, the angels addressed their Provider, saying:

“…Will You place on it those who will corrupt and shed blood…”:

that is, will this creature do as the jinn have already done, and act as the devil and his offspring have previously behaved?

“…we glorify with Your Praise…”:

we make the spirits of Your creatures glorify Your Favor by inspiring them, acquainting them with Your Charity and the great care for which You are praised. The angel inspires you, saying, “you, man, turn towards God, think and seek your own happiness. You, spirit, obey God’s Words, contemplate the universe, and find the signs that indicate Al’lah.” “…and purify for You…”: so, we make their spirits pure by their entry into Your Presence; we purify these spirits for You. We make them glorify the things for which You are praised, and purify their hearts so that they are fit to enter Your Presence. If You make us successors, we will do whatever will bring benefit to Your creatures; we will be the means for their spirits to be led to You; we will let them enter Your Presence. The Almighty then addressed them:

“…He said: ‘I know what you do not know’ “:

that is, I know things about the capability and the qualifications of this man that you do not know. Adam is superior to you and is even more elevated than you.

Similarly, a perfect believer is more elevated than the noble angels, and a person has the potential to be higher than everything, although an unbeliever is the lowest of everything.

The animal has come and performed its function, and so it will be punished in the worldly life in the case that it deviates from what it should do. The Fire will not be its resort on Doomsday. It receives its punishment only in this lower life.

As for the unbeliever, tomorrow they will throw themselves into the Fire; the dog is better than those among people who do not believe.

The Almighty God created our master Adam (pth) and brought him into existence, and Adam (pth) praised his Creator’s favor for him and appreciated His Charity. Through such praise and appreciation his spirit turned towards the Almighty God, entering His Presence.

The human spirit is like a clean mirror. Wherever you direct it, the effects of whatever it is facing are printed upon it.
